attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.enrollment_eligibility_span. Business justification: Required for claim adjudication to determine member's eligibility span at service date, supporting CMS reporting and accurate cost‑share calculations.

attributes.name: formulary_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.formulary. Business justification: Pharmacy claims are adjudicated against a specific formulary — the formulary determines coverage status, tier assignment, cost-sharing, and PA requirements. pharmacy_claim.formulary_tier (STRING) is a

attributes.name: grace_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.grace_period. Business justification: ACA marketplace regulations require pharmacy claims adjudicated during a 90-day grace period to be tracked for potential reversal if premium goes unpaid. Health insurance operations must link each pha

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.header. Business justification: Required for integrated care reporting: links pharmacy claims to the corresponding medical claim header for episode‑of‑care analysis and coordinated benefits calculations.

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Surrogate reference to the health plan or benefit plan under which this pharmacy claim was adjudicated. Links to the plan and benefit product. Determines formulary, cost-sharing rules, and CMS Part D contract identification.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Plan Benefit Package (PBP); ACA QHP Standards

attributes.name: member_identity_id
attributes.description: Surrogate reference to the health plan member who is the beneficiary of this pharmacy claim. Links to the member master record in the Core Administration Platform (Facets/QNXT). Required for eligibility verification, coordination of benefits (COB), and CMS Part D risk adjustment (RAF/HCC).
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164; CMS Part D EDPS/RAPS

attributes.name: member_risk_score_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.member_risk_score. Business justification: Risk‑adjusted claim adjudication report requires each claim to reference the member's risk score to apply CMS risk adjustment factors.

attributes.name: pharmacy_claim_pbm_transaction_id
attributes.description: Source system transaction identifier assigned by the PBM system (RxClaim or Argus) at the time of adjudication. Used for claim traceability, PBM reconciliation, EDI 835 remittance matching, and pharmacy audit trail. Enables lineage back to the operational system of record.
attributes.references: RxClaim/Argus PBM System; NCPDP D.0 Transaction Reference; HIPAA EDI 835

attributes.name: pharmacy_claim_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.enrollment_transaction. Business justification: Provides audit link between each pharmacy claim and the enrollment transaction that established coverage, needed for reconciliation and regulatory audit.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_id
attributes.description: Surrogate reference to the prior authorization record that approved dispensing of this drug, if applicable. Null when no PA was required. Links to the utilization management PA product. Required for specialty drug claims and step therapy override tracking.
attributes.references: NCPDP D.0 Field 462-EV; CMS Part D PA Requirements

attributes.name: provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.provider_contract. Business justification: Claim adjudication uses PBM contract rates, step‑therapy and rebate rules; linking claim to provider_contract enables accurate pricing and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Surrogate reference to the prescribing provider who authored the prescription. Links to the provider master record in the Provider Management System (Cactus/ProviderSource). Used for prescriber profiling, fraud/waste/abuse (FWA) detection, and HEDIS measure attribution.

attributes.name: um_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to utilization.um_case. Business justification: Claims are associated with utilization‑management cases for case‑level cost analysis and outcome tracking, required by case management dashboards.

attributes.name: adjudication_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the pharmacy claim was adjudicated (approved or rejected) by the PBM system. Distinct from fill_date (dispensing event). Used for claims processing SLA measurement, 835 remittance matching, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: NCPDP D.0; HIPAA 835 Remittance; CMS Part D EDPS

attributes.name: basis_of_cost_determination
attributes.description: Code indicating the pricing benchmark used to determine the ingredient cost for this claim. AWP = Average Wholesale Price; WAC = Wholesale Acquisition Cost; MAC = Maximum Allowable Cost; usual_and_customary = pharmacy's standard retail price; negotiated = contracted rate; 340B = 340B program pricing; other = alternative basis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: awp|wac|mac|usual_and_customary|negotiated|340b|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NCPDP D.0 Field 423-DN; CMS Part D Pricing Rules; 340B Drug Pricing Program (HRSA)

attributes.name: claim_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable claim reference number assigned by the Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) system (RxClaim or Argus) at adjudication. Used for member communications, Explanation of Benefits (EOB), and 835 remittance reconciliation. Maps to NCPDP D.0 transaction reference number.
attributes.references: NCPDP SCRIPT Standard D.0; CMS Part D Encounter Data Processing System (EDPS)

attributes.name: claim_status
attributes.description: Current adjudication lifecycle status of the pharmacy claim as determined by the PBM system. 'paid' = claim adjudicated and payment issued; 'rejected' = claim denied with reject code; 'reversed' = previously paid claim reversed; 'adjusted' = claim reprocessed with changed amounts; 'pending' = awaiting adjudication; 'void' = cancelled before processing.
attributes.references: NCPDP D.0 Transaction Response; CMS Part D EDPS Claim Status Codes

attributes.name: cob_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether coordination of benefits (COB) was applied on this claim (True = COB applied, another payer was involved). Triggers COB segment processing and other_payer_amount population. Used for COB reconciliation and CMS Part D TrOOP calculations.
attributes.references: NCPDP D.0 COB Segment; HIPAA COB Rules; CMS Part D TrOOP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pharmacy claim record was first created in the Silver layer data product. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and HIPAA record retention requirements. RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: daw_code
attributes.description: NCPDP Dispense As Written (DAW) code indicating whether a brand drug was dispensed when a generic was available, and the reason. 0 = no product selection indicated; 1 = substitution not allowed by prescriber; 2 = substitution allowed, patient requested brand; 3 = substitution allowed, pharmacist selected brand; 4 = substitution allowed, generic not in stock; 5 = substitution allowed, brand dispensed as generic. Used for generic substitution rate analytics and formulary compliance.
attributes.references: NCPDP D.0 Field 408-D8 (DAW/Product Selection Code); CMS Part D Generic Substitution

attributes.name: days_supply
attributes.description: Number of days of medication supply dispensed on this claim as reported by the dispensing pharmacy. Used for refill-too-soon edits, medication adherence (MPR/PDC) calculations, HEDIS pharmacy measures, and CMS Part D days supply validation.
attributes.references: NCPDP D.0 Field 405-D5; CMS Part D Days Supply Rules; HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: deductible_applied
attributes.description: Dollar amount of this pharmacy claim applied toward the member's pharmacy or combined medical/pharmacy deductible. Relevant for HDHP/HSA plans and CMS Part D deductible phase tracking. Contributes to OOP/MOOP accumulation.
attributes.references: NCPDP D.0; ACA Deductible Rules; CMS Part D Benefit Phases

attributes.name: dispensing_fee
attributes.description: Fee charged by the dispensing pharmacy for the act of dispensing the prescription, separate from ingredient cost. Negotiated as part of the PBM network contract. Used for PBM contract reconciliation and total claim cost analysis.
attributes.references: NCPDP D.0 Field 412-DC; CMS Part D Dispensing Fee Rules

attributes.name: dispensing_pharmacy_npi
attributes.description: 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the dispensing pharmacy as submitted on the pharmacy claim. Denormalized for claim-level auditability and NCPDP D.0 compliance. Used for pharmacy network validation, audit trail, and CMS Part D encounter data.
attributes.references: HIPAA NPI Final Rule 45 CFR §162.406; NCPDP D.0 Field 201-B1

attributes.name: dur_outcome_code
attributes.description: NCPDP standard code indicating the outcome of the prospective drug utilization review (DUR) edit performed during adjudication (e.g., drug-drug interaction, duplicate therapy, dose check). Null if no DUR alert was triggered. Critical for pharmacy safety and regulatory compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product — NCPDP DUR outcome codes exceed 6 values]
attributes.references: NCPDP D.0 DUR/PPS Segment Field 439-E4; CMS Part D DUR Requirements

attributes.name: fill_date
attributes.description: The date the prescription was dispensed by the pharmacy to the member. This is the principal real-world business event date (BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category). Used for days supply calculations, refill-too-soon edits, and CMS Part D encounter data date of service reporting.
attributes.references: NCPDP D.0 Field 401-D1 (Date of Service); CMS Part D EDPS

attributes.name: ingredient_cost
attributes.description: The cost of the drug ingredient(s) as billed by the dispensing pharmacy, before dispensing fee and other adjustments. Basis may be AWP, WAC, MAC, or negotiated rate. Core component of the MONETARY_TRIPLET for pharmacy claim financials. Used for PBM contract reconciliation and MLR calculation.
attributes.references: NCPDP D.0 Field 409-D9; CMS Part D Direct and Indirect Remuneration (DIR)

attributes.name: is_340b_claim
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pharmacy claim was dispensed under the 340B Drug Pricing Program (True = 340B claim). Used for 340B duplicate discount prevention, HRSA compliance reporting, and separation of 340B and non-340B claims in financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: HRSA 340B Drug Pricing Program; CMS Part D 340B Duplicate Discount Policy

attributes.name: is_compound_claim
attributes.description: Indicates whether this claim is for a compounded drug product containing multiple ingredients (True = compound claim). Compound claims require line-level detail in the pharmacy_claim_line product. Used for compound drug utilization review and cost management.
attributes.references: NCPDP D.0 Compound Segment; CMS Part D Compound Drug Rules

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Line of business under which this pharmacy claim was adjudicated. Drives regulatory reporting requirements, formulary rules, and cost-sharing structures. 'commercial' = employer-sponsored or individual; 'medicare_part_d' = CMS Medicare Part D; 'medicaid' = state Medicaid; 'exchange' = ACA marketplace QHP; 'cobra' = COBRA continuation coverage.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; ACA QHP Standards; NAIC LOB Reporting; ERISA

attributes.name: member_coinsurance
attributes.description: Percentage-based cost-sharing amount paid by the member for this pharmacy claim, calculated as a percentage of the allowed cost. Applies when the benefit design uses coinsurance rather than fixed copay. Contributes to OOP/MOOP accumulation.
attributes.references: NCPDP D.0; ACA Cost-Sharing Rules; CMS Part D Benefit Design

attributes.name: member_copay
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount paid by the member at point of sale as their cost-sharing obligation for this pharmacy claim. Determined by formulary tier and benefit design. Contributes to member out-of-pocket (OOP) and maximum out-of-pocket (MOOP) accumulation.
attributes.references: NCPDP D.0 Field 506-F6; ACA MOOP Limits; CMS Part D Cost-Sharing Rules

attributes.name: ndc
attributes.description: 11-digit National Drug Code identifying the specific drug product dispensed, including labeler, product, and package segment. Denormalized from the drug master for claim-level auditability and CMS Part D encounter data submission (EDPS). Required for 340B duplicate discount prevention and drug utilization review (DUR).
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; NCPDP D.0 Field 407-D7; CMS Part D EDPS

attributes.name: original_claim_number
attributes.description: Claim number of the original pharmacy claim that this record adjusts or reverses. Populated only for adjusted or reversed claims; null for original claims. Enables claim adjustment chain tracing for financial reconciliation, audit, and CMS Part D encounter data correction submissions.
attributes.references: NCPDP D.0 Claim Adjustment; CMS Part D EDPS Adjustment Processing; HIPAA 835

attributes.name: pharmacy_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the drug was dispensed. Drives cost-sharing differentials, formulary tier rules, and network adequacy reporting. 'retail' = community pharmacy; 'mail_order' = 90-day mail service; 'specialty' = specialty pharmacy for high-cost/complex drugs; 'long_term_care' = SNF/LTC pharmacy; 'home_infusion' = infusion therapy at home.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Pharmacy Type Codes; NCPDP D.0 Pharmacy Service Type

attributes.name: plan_paid_amount
attributes.description: Total amount paid by the health plan for this pharmacy claim after applying member cost-sharing (copay, coinsurance, deductible) and COB adjustments. Net total component of the MONETARY_TRIPLET. Used for 835 remittance, MLR reporting, and CMS Part D encounter data.
attributes.references: NCPDP D.0 Field 505-F5; HIPAA 835 Remittance; CMS Part D EDPS

attributes.name: prescriber_npi
attributes.description: 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the prescribing provider as submitted on the pharmacy claim. Denormalized for claim-level auditability, NCPDP D.0 compliance, and CMS Part D encounter data submission. Used for prescriber fraud/waste/abuse (FWA) analytics.
attributes.references: HIPAA NPI Final Rule 45 CFR §162.406; NCPDP D.0 Field 411-DB; CMS NPI Registry

attributes.name: prescription_written_date
attributes.description: Date the prescription was written by the prescriber. Used to validate prescription age, enforce days-supply-from-written-date rules, and support medication adherence analytics. Distinct from fill_date (dispensing date).
attributes.references: NCPDP D.0 Field 414-DE (Date Prescription Written); State Pharmacy Board Regulations

attributes.name: quantity_dispensed
attributes.description: Actual quantity of the drug dispensed (e.g., number of tablets, milliliters, grams) as reported by the dispensing pharmacy. Used for quantity limit (QL) edits, drug utilization review (DUR), and CMS Part D encounter data submission.
attributes.references: NCPDP D.0 Field 442-E7; CMS Part D EDPS Quantity Dispensed

attributes.name: quantity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: NCPDP standard unit of measure code for the quantity dispensed. EA = each (tablets/capsules); ML = milliliters; GM = grams; UN = units; F2 = international units; ME = milliequivalents. Required for accurate quantity limit (QL) edit enforcement and CMS Part D encounter data.
attributes.references: NCPDP D.0 Field 600-28 (Unit of Measure); CMS Part D EDPS

attributes.name: refill_number
attributes.description: Refill sequence number for this dispensing event. Zero (0) indicates the original fill; subsequent values indicate refill number. Used for refill-too-soon edits, medication adherence tracking, and prescription lifecycle management.
attributes.references: NCPDP D.0 Field 403-D3; CMS Part D Refill Rules

attributes.name: reject_code
attributes.description: NCPDP standard reject code returned by the PBM system when a claim is rejected or denied. Null for paid claims. Used for pharmacy operations, member appeals, and drug utilization review (DUR) outcome tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product — NCPDP reject codes exceed 6 values]
attributes.references: NCPDP D.0 Reject Code List; CMS Part D Reject Code Requirements

attributes.name: sales_tax
attributes.description: Sales tax amount applied to the pharmacy claim where applicable by state law. Included in total claim cost and reported separately for financial reconciliation and statutory accounting (SAP) purposes.
attributes.references: NCPDP D.0 Field 481-HA; State Tax Regulations

attributes.name: step_therapy_override
attributes.description: Indicates whether a step therapy protocol was overridden for this claim (True = override applied). Step therapy requires trying lower-cost drugs before approving higher-cost alternatives. Override requires prior authorization. Used for utilization management (UM) reporting and CMS step therapy compliance.
attributes.references: CMS Step Therapy Rule (42 CFR §422.136); NCQA UM Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pharmacy claim record was last modified in the Silver layer, such as after a claim adjustment, reversal, or COB update. Supports change data capture (CDC) and audit trail requirements. RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312; Internal Data Governance Policy

products.name: claim_line
products.description: Line-level detail for pharmacy claims supporting multi-ingredient compound claims and coordination of benefits (COB) line splits. Captures line sequence, NDC, ingredient cost, dispensing fee, sales tax, incentive amount, other payer amount, patient pay amount, and basis of cost determination. Enables granular adjudication audit trails and compound drug cost analysis.

attributes.name: claim_line_id
attributes.description: Primary key for claim_line

attributes.name: drug_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the drug master record for the dispensed drug on this claim line, enabling linkage to formulary, tier, and pricing data.
attributes.references: NDC Drug Master; CMS Part D Drug Data

attributes.name: formulary_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formulary under which this drug was adjudicated, determining tier assignment, coverage rules, and cost-sharing obligations.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Requirements; PBM Formulary Management

attributes.name: pharmacy_claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent pharmacy claim header to which this line belongs. Establishes the header/detail relationship for multi-line and compound drug claims.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 837D Transaction Set; NCPDP SCRIPT Standard

attributes.name: prior_authorization_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prior authorization record approved for this drug line, required for specialty and non-formulary drugs. Null if no PA was required.
attributes.references: HIPAA EDI 278 Transaction; CMS Part D PA Requirements

attributes.name: provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.provider_contract. Business justification: Line‑level pricing and cost allocation depend on the specific PBM contract; the FK supports detailed cost breakdowns for audits and CMS reporting.

attributes.name: adjudication_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this pharmacy claim line was adjudicated by the PBM system (RxClaim or Argus). Represents the business event timestamp for the adjudication transaction. Used for audit trails and processing SLA measurement.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; CMS Part D PDE Reporting; HIPAA EDI 835

attributes.name: basis_of_cost_determination
attributes.description: Code indicating the pricing benchmark used to determine the ingredient cost for this claim line. Values include Average Wholesale Price (AWP), Wholesale Acquisition Cost (WAC), Maximum Allowable Cost (MAC), Federal Upper Limit (FUL), NADAC, negotiated rate, usual and customary, or other. Critical for PBM audit and CMS Part D compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AWP|WAC|MAC|FUL|NADAC|negotiated|usual_and_customary|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Part D PDE Reporting; NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; 42 CFR Part 423

attributes.name: catastrophic_coverage_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this claim line was adjudicated under the catastrophic coverage phase of the Part D benefit, where the plan pays a higher percentage of drug costs after the member's True Out-of-Pocket (TrOOP) threshold is met.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Benefit Phases; 42 CFR Part 423; CMS PDE Reporting

attributes.name: cob_sequence
attributes.description: Indicates the payer sequence in a Coordination of Benefits (COB) scenario. 1=primary payer, 2=secondary payer, 3=tertiary payer. Used to correctly apply COB rules and calculate each payer's liability on this claim line.
attributes.references: HIPAA COB Rules; NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; CMS COB Requirements

attributes.name: compound_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this claim line is part of a compounded drug prescription. When true, multiple ingredient lines will exist under the same claim header, each with its own NDC and ingredient cost.
attributes.references: NCPDP Compound Drug Billing Standard; CMS Part D Compound Drug Policy

attributes.name: coverage_gap_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this claim line was adjudicated during the Part D coverage gap (donut hole) phase. Used for manufacturer discount program tracking and CMS Part D benefit phase reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Coverage Gap; ACA Coverage Gap Discount Program; 42 CFR Part 423

attributes.name: days_supply
attributes.description: Number of days of medication supply dispensed on this claim line as reported by the dispensing pharmacy. Used for refill-too-soon edits, adherence calculations, and HEDIS medication adherence measures.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; HEDIS Medication Adherence Measures; CMS Part D

attributes.name: dispense_as_written_code
attributes.description: NCPDP Dispense As Written (DAW) code indicating whether the prescriber or member requested brand-name dispensing when a generic was available. DAW 0=no product selection indicated, DAW 1=substitution not allowed by prescriber, DAW 2=substitution allowed-patient requested brand. Impacts cost-sharing and GDR calculations.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard DAW Codes; CMS Part D DAW Reporting

attributes.name: dispensed_date
attributes.description: Date the drug was dispensed to the member at the pharmacy. Represents the real-world service event date used for benefit period calculations, days supply tracking, and CMS Part D reporting.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; CMS Part D PDE Reporting

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_amount
attributes.description: The fee charged by the dispensing pharmacy for the professional service of dispensing the medication. Negotiated as part of PBM network contracts and reported separately from ingredient cost per CMS Part D requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Part D PDE Reporting; NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; PBM Network Contract Terms

attributes.name: drug_coverage_status
attributes.description: Coverage determination status for this drug on the applicable formulary at time of adjudication. Indicates whether the drug is covered, non-covered, excluded, subject to step therapy, or requires prior authorization (PA).
attributes.references: CMS Part D Coverage Determination; NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; ACA Essential Health Benefits

attributes.name: dur_conflict_code
attributes.description: NCPDP DUR conflict code identifying the type of drug utilization issue detected during adjudication (e.g., drug-drug interaction, drug-disease contraindication, duplicate therapy, high dose). Supports clinical safety monitoring and regulatory DUR reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product for full NCPDP DUR conflict code set]
attributes.references: NCPDP DUR Standard; CMS Part D DUR Requirements; OBRA 90

attributes.name: dur_outcome_code
attributes.description: NCPDP Drug Utilization Review (DUR) outcome code recorded during adjudication, indicating the pharmacist's action taken in response to a DUR alert (e.g., filled as is, filled with prescriber approval, not filled). Supports clinical safety audit trails. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product for full NCPDP DUR outcome code set]
attributes.references: NCPDP DUR Standard; CMS Part D DUR Requirements; OBRA 90

attributes.name: fill_number
attributes.description: Sequential fill number for this prescription across all fills, including original and all refills. Distinct from refill_number in that it counts total fills rather than refill sequence. Used for prescription lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; RxClaim/Argus PBM System

attributes.name: formulary_tier
attributes.description: Drug formulary tier assigned to this drug at the time of adjudication, determining the member's cost-sharing level (e.g., Tier 1 generic, Tier 2 preferred brand, Tier 3 non-preferred brand, Tier 4 specialty). Drives copay/coinsurance calculation.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Requirements; NCQA Formulary Standards; PBM Formulary Design

attributes.name: generic_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dispensed drug is a generic equivalent. Used for generic dispensing rate (GDR) reporting, formulary compliance analytics, and PBM performance measurement.
attributes.references: FDA Generic Drug Approval; NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; HEDIS GDR Measure

attributes.name: gross_drug_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total gross cost of the drug on this claim line, calculated as ingredient cost plus dispensing fee plus sales tax plus incentive amount. Used as the basis for CMS Part D gross drug cost reporting and risk corridor calculations.
attributes.references: CMS Part D PDE Reporting; 42 CFR Part 423

attributes.name: incentive_amount
attributes.description: Incentive or bonus amount paid to the pharmacy for performance-based or preferred network participation on this claim line. Included in gross drug cost calculations for CMS Part D reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Part D PDE Reporting; NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; PBM Performance Contract

attributes.name: ingredient_cost_amount
attributes.description: The drug ingredient cost component of the claim line, representing the cost of the drug itself exclusive of dispensing fee, sales tax, and other charges. Key input for MAC/AWP/WAC-based reimbursement calculations and compound drug cost analysis.
attributes.references: CMS Part D PDE Reporting; NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; MAC/AWP/WAC Pricing Standards

attributes.name: line_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number identifying the position of this line within the parent pharmacy claim. Used to order compound ingredient lines and COB line splits. Starts at 1.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current adjudication status of this pharmacy claim line. Drives payment processing, COB resolution, and audit reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: paid|denied|reversed|adjusted|pending|void — promote to reference product if additional statuses are needed]
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; HIPAA EDI 835; CMS Part D

attributes.name: line_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of this claim line: standard single-drug fill, compound ingredient line, COB line split, reversal, or adjustment. Drives compound cost analysis and COB workflows.
attributes.references: NCPDP Compound Drug Billing; HIPAA COB Rules

attributes.name: low_income_subsidy_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member received a Low Income Subsidy (LIS) benefit on this claim line, resulting in reduced cost-sharing. Required for CMS Part D PDE reporting and LIS reconciliation.
attributes.references: CMS Part D LIS Requirements; 42 CFR Part 423 Subpart P; CMS PDE Reporting

attributes.name: manufacturer_discount_amount
attributes.description: Amount of manufacturer discount applied to this claim line under the CMS Part D Coverage Gap Discount Program. Counts toward the member's TrOOP and is reported on the PDE record.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Coverage Gap Discount Program; 42 CFR Part 423; CMS PDE Reporting

attributes.name: ndc_code
attributes.description: 11-digit National Drug Code identifying the specific drug product, strength, and package size dispensed on this claim line. Sourced from FDA NDC Directory. PHI when linked to a member.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; HIPAA EDI 837D; CMS Part D Reporting

attributes.name: patient_pay_amount
attributes.description: Total amount paid by the member/patient at point of sale, including copay, coinsurance, and deductible contributions. Used for Out-of-Pocket (OOP) accumulator tracking and Maximum Out-of-Pocket (MOOP) calculations.
attributes.references: ACA OOP Maximum Rules; CMS Part D TrOOP; NCPDP Telecommunication Standard

attributes.name: pde_submission_date
attributes.description: Date this claim line was submitted to CMS as a Prescription Drug Event (PDE) record for Part D reconciliation and risk adjustment. Null for non-Part D claims. Critical for CMS compliance and audit.
attributes.references: CMS Part D PDE Reporting Requirements; 42 CFR Part 423; CMS RAPS/EDPS

attributes.name: pharmacy_channel
attributes.description: Distribution channel through which the drug was dispensed: retail pharmacy, mail-order pharmacy, specialty pharmacy, long-term care (LTC) pharmacy, or home infusion. Drives network contract application, reimbursement rates, and utilization analytics.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Pharmacy Type Codes; NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; PBM Network Contract

attributes.name: plan_paid_amount
attributes.description: Net amount paid by the health plan on this claim line after applying member cost-sharing, COB adjustments, and other payer amounts. Core financial metric for MLR and PMPM reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Part D PDE Reporting; NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; ACA MLR Rules

attributes.name: quantity_dispensed
attributes.description: Actual quantity of the drug dispensed (e.g., number of tablets, milliliters, grams) as reported by the pharmacy. Used for quantity limit edits, compound ingredient cost allocation, and drug utilization review (DUR).
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; CMS Part D PDE; FDA NDC

attributes.name: quantity_limit_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a quantity limit restriction was applied to this drug claim line during adjudication. When true, the dispensed quantity was subject to plan-defined quantity limit rules.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Quantity Limit Policy; NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; PBM Formulary Management

attributes.name: refill_number
attributes.description: Refill sequence number for this prescription fill. Zero indicates the original fill; subsequent values indicate refill number. Used for refill-too-soon edits, adherence monitoring, and quantity limit enforcement.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; CMS Part D Refill Rules; State Pharmacy Board Regulations

attributes.name: reversal_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this pharmacy claim line was reversed, if applicable. Null for non-reversed lines. Used for financial reconciliation, audit trails, and identifying reversed claims in PMPM and MLR calculations.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; CMS Part D PDE Reversal Reporting; HIPAA EDI 835

attributes.name: sales_tax_amount
attributes.description: State or local sales tax applied to this pharmacy claim line where applicable. Reported separately per CMS Part D PDE requirements. Zero or null in states with no drug sales tax.
attributes.references: CMS Part D PDE Reporting; NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; State Tax Regulations

attributes.name: source_system_claim_line_key
attributes.description: Natural key or transaction identifier for this claim line as assigned by the originating PBM system (RxClaim or Argus). Used for lineage tracing, reconciliation with source system, and EDI transaction matching.
attributes.references: Internal Data Lineage Standard; HIPAA EDI 837D; RxClaim/Argus PBM System

attributes.name: specialty_drug_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug dispensed on this line is classified as a specialty drug, typically requiring special handling, storage, or administration and subject to specialty pharmacy channel requirements and PA rules.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Specialty Drug Definition; NCQA Specialty Pharmacy Standards; PBM Specialty Drug List

attributes.name: step_therapy_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this drug claim line was subject to a step therapy protocol requiring the member to try a preferred or lower-cost drug before coverage of this drug was approved.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Step Therapy Rules; NCQA Utilization Management Standards; State Step Therapy Laws

attributes.name: true_oop_amount
attributes.description: Member's True Out-of-Pocket (TrOOP) cost contribution from this claim line, used to track progress toward the Part D catastrophic coverage threshold. Includes patient pay and applicable manufacturer discounts.
attributes.references: CMS Part D TrOOP Rules; 42 CFR Part 423; CMS PDE Reporting

products.name: prior_authorization
products.description: Prior authorization (PA) record for specialty and non-preferred drugs requiring clinical review before dispensing. Captures PA request date, requesting prescriber NPI, member ID, drug NDC, diagnosis codes (ICD), clinical criteria applied (InterQual/MCG), authorization status (approved/denied/pending), approved quantity, approved days supply, effective date range, and denial reason codes. Interfaces with the Utilization Management system and supports CMS Part D PA reporting.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_id
attributes.description: Primary key for prior_authorization

attributes.name: case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to appeal.appeal_case. Business justification: Needed for the 'Prior Authorization Appeal' workflow; links a PA request to its appeal case for audit, compliance, and outcome reporting.

attributes.name: clinical_criteria_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to utilization.clinical_criteria. Business justification: Pharmacy PAs are evaluated against specific clinical criteria (InterQual, MCG, plan-specific drug criteria). prior_authorization.clinical_criteria_code is a denormalized reference to clinical_criteria

attributes.name: drug_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.drug_master. Business justification: Prior authorization records are for a specific drug requiring clinical review. prior_authorization.drug_ndc (STRING) is a denormalized NDC field. Normalizing to drug_master_id → drug_master.drug_maste

attributes.name: enrollment_eligibility_span_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.enrollment_eligibility_span. Business justification: PA adjudication requires validating the member's active eligibility span to confirm coverage tier, benefit year, LOB, and network at time of PA request. Health plan PA systems routinely join PA record

attributes.name: formulary_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the formulary associated with the member's plan at the time of the prior authorization request. Determines drug tier, coverage rules, and applicable PA criteria.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Requirements; PBM Formulary Management (RxClaim/Argus)

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the health plan or benefit plan under which the prior authorization is being evaluated. Determines applicable formulary, tier rules, and PA criteria.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Plan Benefit Package; ACA Qualified Health Plan (QHP) Requirements

attributes.name: medicare_entitlement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.medicare_entitlement. Business justification: Medicare Part D PA processing requires referencing the member's entitlement record for LIS/Extra Help status, Part D enrollment effective date, and dual-eligible indicators. prior_authorization.cms_pa

attributes.name: member_risk_score_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.member_risk_score. Business justification: Prior‑authorization workflow uses the member's risk score to assess clinical necessity and cost containment, mandated by internal utilization management policies.

attributes.name: member_subscriber_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the health plan member for whom the prior authorization is requested. Links to the member master record in the Core Administration Platform (Facets/QNXT).
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR §164; CMS Part D Enrollment

attributes.name: original_pa_prior_authorization_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original prior authorization record when this record represents a renewal, appeal, or modification. Enables tracking of the full PA lifecycle chain. Null for initial requests.
attributes.references: CMS Part D PA Continuity; URAC UM Standards

attributes.name: pa_request_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to utilization.pa_request. Business justification: Required for PA audit report linking each prior authorization record to its originating request, enabling traceability of request‑to‑authorization lifecycle.

attributes.name: prescriber_provider_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.provider_provider. Business justification: PA requests are submitted by prescribing providers; health plans must validate prescriber credentials, network participation, and specialty when adjudicating PAs. This is a core UM/PA workflow. prescr

attributes.name: um_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to utilization.um_program. Business justification: Pharmacy PA requests are administered under specific UM programs (specialty drug UM, Part D UM, commercial drug UM). Linking prior_authorization to um_program supports UM program performance reporting

attributes.name: appeal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this prior authorization record is associated with a member or prescriber appeal of a prior denial. True = this PA is an appeal case.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Appeals and Grievances Requirements; URAC UM Standards; State DOI Appeal Regulations

attributes.name: approved_days_supply
attributes.description: Number of days of drug therapy authorized under this prior authorization. Used by the PBM to enforce dispensing limits and by CMS Part D for compliance reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Days Supply Rules; NCPDP Telecommunication Standard

attributes.name: approved_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of the drug authorized for dispensing under this prior authorization (e.g., number of tablets, milliliters, units). Enforced at point-of-sale by the PBM adjudication system.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Quantity Limit Rules; NCPDP Telecommunication Standard

attributes.name: approved_refills
attributes.description: Number of refills authorized under this prior authorization in addition to the initial fill. Enforced by the PBM adjudication system at point-of-sale.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; DEA Controlled Substance Regulations

attributes.name: clinical_criteria_version
attributes.description: Version of the clinical criteria set (InterQual or MCG) applied at the time of the prior authorization decision. Required for audit trails and appeals to ensure the correct criteria version is referenced.
attributes.references: InterQual Clinical Criteria; MCG Care Guidelines; URAC UM Accreditation

attributes.name: cms_part_d_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Part D Reportable Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this prior authorization record is subject to CMS Part D PA reporting requirements. True = must be included in CMS Part D PA reporting submissions.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prior Authorization Reporting Requirements; 42 CFR §423

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this prior authorization record was first created in the Silver Layer data platform. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and Silver Layer processing compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA Audit Controls 45 CFR §164.312; Enterprise Data Governance; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Standards

attributes.name: criteria_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the submitted clinical information met the applicable clinical criteria (InterQual/MCG) for the requested drug. True = criteria met (supports approval); False = criteria not met (supports denial).
attributes.references: InterQual Clinical Criteria; MCG Care Guidelines; CMS Part D PA Requirements

attributes.name: decision_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time the prior authorization decision (approval, denial, or pend) was rendered by the clinical reviewer or automated adjudication engine. Used to calculate turnaround time against CMS and URAC standards.
attributes.references: CMS Part D PA Timeliness Standards; URAC UM Accreditation; NCQA Accreditation

attributes.name: denial_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for denial of the prior authorization request (e.g., not medically necessary, step therapy not completed, quantity limit exceeded, non-covered drug). Populated only when pa_status = denied. Used for member appeals and CMS Part D reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Denial Reason Codes; NCPDP Reject Codes; URAC UM Standards

attributes.name: denial_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the denial reason, providing clinical or administrative context beyond the denial reason code. Included in member and prescriber denial notices per CMS and state DOI requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Denial Notice Requirements; State DOI Adverse Determination Notice Rules; URAC UM Standards

attributes.name: dispensing_channel
attributes.description: Pharmacy dispensing channel authorized for this prior authorization (retail, mail-order, specialty pharmacy, long-term care, or home infusion). Determines which pharmacy network is eligible to dispense.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Pharmacy Network Requirements; NCPDP Pharmacy Type Codes; PBM Network Management

attributes.name: drug_tier
attributes.description: Formulary tier of the requested drug at the time of the prior authorization request. Determines cost-sharing obligations and PA criteria applied.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Tier Requirements; PBM Formulary Management (RxClaim/Argus)

attributes.name: dur_outcome_code
attributes.description: NCPDP-standardized Drug Utilization Review (DUR) outcome code resulting from prospective DUR screening performed during PA adjudication (e.g., drug-drug interaction, drug-disease contraindication, duplicate therapy). Sourced from PBM system (RxClaim/Argus).
attributes.references: NCPDP DUR Standard; CMS Part D DUR Requirements; OBRA 1990 DUR Mandate

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the prior authorization expires and is no longer valid for dispensing. After this date, a new PA request is required. Nullable for open-ended authorizations.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; PBM Adjudication Rules

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which the approved prior authorization is valid for dispensing. Pharmacies and PBM adjudication systems use this date to confirm dispensing eligibility.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; PBM Adjudication Rules

attributes.name: icd_diagnosis_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases (ICD) Primary Diagnosis Code
attributes.description: Primary ICD-10-CM diagnosis code submitted by the prescriber to support the clinical necessity of the requested drug. Required for clinical criteria evaluation and CMS Part D PA reporting. Contains Protected Health Information (PHI).
attributes.references: WHO ICD-10-CM; CMS Part D Clinical Criteria; HIPAA 45 CFR §164 PHI

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: Line of Business (LOB) under which the member's coverage falls, determining applicable regulatory requirements, formulary rules, and PA criteria (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Part D, Medicaid, ACA Marketplace).
attributes.references: CMS Part D; ACA Qualified Health Plan (QHP); NAIC Model Laws; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text clinical notes entered by the reviewing clinician during the prior authorization evaluation, capturing clinical rationale, additional context, or instructions for the prescriber or pharmacy. Contains Protected Health Information (PHI).
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR §164; CMS Part D PA Documentation Requirements; URAC UM Standards

attributes.name: pa_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable prior authorization reference number assigned by the Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) system (RxClaim or Argus) or Utilization Management (UM) system (InterQual/MCG). Used on Explanation of Benefits (EOB) and communicated to prescribers and pharmacies.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NCPDP SCRIPT Standard; HIPAA 278 Transaction

attributes.name: pa_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the prior authorization request. Drives dispensing eligibility at the pharmacy and CMS Part D PA reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: approved|denied|pending|cancelled|expired|appealed — promote to reference product if additional statuses are needed]
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prior Authorization; NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; HIPAA 278 Transaction

attributes.name: pa_type
attributes.description: Category of prior authorization criteria applied, indicating the clinical or formulary reason the drug requires PA review (e.g., specialty drug, non-preferred tier, step therapy requirement, quantity limit, age restriction, off-label use). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: specialty|non_preferred|step_therapy|quantity_limit|age_restriction|off_label — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary and PA Requirements; PBM Formulary Management

attributes.name: quantity_limit_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether a quantity limit restriction was a factor in the prior authorization evaluation. True = quantity limit rules were applied during adjudication.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Quantity Limit Requirements; PBM Formulary Management (RxClaim/Argus)

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time the prior authorization request was received by the Utilization Management (UM) system (InterQual/MCG) or PBM system (RxClaim/Argus). Used for precise turnaround time calculation and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: CMS Part D PA Timeliness; URAC UM Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the prior authorization request was submitted by the prescriber or pharmacy. Used for turnaround time measurement and CMS Part D compliance reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Part D PA Timeliness Standards; URAC Drug Therapy Management Standards

attributes.name: request_type
attributes.description: Classification of the prior authorization request indicating whether it is a new request, renewal of an existing authorization, appeal of a denial, expedited urgent request, or retrospective review.
attributes.references: CMS Part D PA Requirements; URAC UM Standards; NCQA Accreditation

attributes.name: review_level
attributes.description: Level of clinical review applied to the prior authorization request, indicating whether it was reviewed by a pharmacist, physician, peer-to-peer consultation, or medical director. Escalation level affects turnaround time standards.
attributes.references: URAC UM Accreditation Standards; NCQA Accreditation; CMS Part D PA Requirements

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this prior authorization record originated (PBM system RxClaim/Argus or UM system InterQual/MCG or Core Admin Platform Facets/QNXT). Used for data lineage and reconciliation in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance; HIPAA Data Provenance; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Standards

attributes.name: source_system_pa_code
attributes.description: Native prior authorization identifier from the originating operational system (RxClaim, Argus, InterQual, or MCG). Preserved for reconciliation, audit, and cross-system traceability in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Standards

attributes.name: specialty_drug_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the requested drug is classified as a specialty drug requiring specialty pharmacy dispensing and enhanced clinical review. Specialty drugs typically have higher cost-sharing and stricter PA criteria.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Specialty Tier Definition; NCPDP Specialty Drug Classification; PBM Formulary Management

attributes.name: step_therapy_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has documented evidence of completing the required step therapy (tried and failed prerequisite drugs) as required by the formulary PA criteria. Populated when step_therapy_required = True.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Step Therapy Rules; NCQA Formulary Management Standards

attributes.name: step_therapy_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prior authorization requires the member to have tried and failed one or more preferred or lower-tier drugs (step therapy) before the requested drug is authorized. True = step therapy applies.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Step Therapy Rules; NCQA Formulary Management Standards; State DOI Step Therapy Laws

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this prior authorization record was last modified in the Silver Layer data platform, reflecting status changes, decision updates, or data corrections. Used for change data capture and audit.
attributes.references: HIPAA Audit Controls 45 CFR §164.312; Enterprise Data Governance; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Standards

products.name: dur_alert
products.description: Drug Utilization Review (DUR) alert record generated during pharmacy claim adjudication. Captures DUR alert type (drug-drug interaction, drug-disease, duplicate therapy, high dose, early refill), severity level, alert code (NCPDP DUR codes), prescriber NPI, dispensing pharmacy NPI, member ID, drug NDC, professional service code, result of service code, and adjudication outcome. Supports prospective and retrospective DUR programs and CMS Part D DUR reporting.
products.reference: NCPDP DUR / CMS Part D DUR

attributes.name: dur_alert_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each Drug Utilization Review (DUR) alert record generated during pharmacy claim adjudication in the Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) system (RxClaim or Argus).
attributes.references: NCPDP SCRIPT Standard; CMS Part D DUR Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: care_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to care.care_enrollment. Business justification: DUR alerts for members enrolled in care management programs must be routed to their assigned care coordinator for clinical follow-up. Linking dur_alert to care_enrollment enables automated alert routi

attributes.name: claim_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmacy claim record against which this DUR alert was generated during adjudication. Links the alert to the originating claim transaction.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; CMS Part D; HIPAA EDI 837P

attributes.name: clinical_criteria_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to utilization.clinical_criteria. Business justification: DUR alerts are evaluated against clinical criteria sets (drug interaction severity thresholds, quantity limit criteria). Linking dur_alert to clinical_criteria supports URAC/NCQA DUR program accredita

attributes.name: dispensing_pharmacy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.dispensing_pharmacy. Business justification: DUR alerts capture dispensing_pharmacy_npi (STRING) as a denormalized identifier. Normalizing this to dispensing_pharmacy_id → dispensing_pharmacy.dispensing_pharmacy_id provides access to the full ph

attributes.name: drug_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.drug_master. Business justification: DUR alerts are generated for a specific drug during adjudication. Linking dur_alert.drug_master_id → drug_master.drug_master_id provides normalized access to the authoritative NDC-level drug record (d

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the health plan or benefit plan under which the member is enrolled at the time of the DUR alert. Used to apply plan-specific DUR rules, formulary restrictions, and CMS Part D contract reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Contract; HIPAA 45 CFR §162; Facets/QNXT Plan Configuration

attributes.name: member_identity_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the health plan member for whom the DUR alert was triggered. Used to associate the alert with the member's medication history and clinical profile.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164; CMS Part D; NCPDP Telecommunication Standard Field 302-C2

attributes.name: pa_request_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to utilization.pa_request. Business justification: DUR alerts with pa_required_flag=true trigger or reference a PA request. Linking dur_alert to pa_request supports DUR-to-PA workflow tracking, NCQA DUR program audits, and CMS Part D compliance report

attributes.name: pbm_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the PBM system (RxClaim or Argus) to the adjudication transaction that generated this DUR alert. Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trail.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; RxClaim/Argus PBM System; CMS Part D

attributes.name: pharmacy_claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.pharmacy_claim. Business justification: DUR alerts are generated during pharmacy claim adjudication and are directly tied to a specific pharmacy claim. Linking dur_alert.pharmacy_claim_id → pharmacy_claim.pharmacy_claim_id establishes the c

attributes.name: prescriber_provider_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.provider_provider. Business justification: DUR alerts require prescriber identification for clinical outreach and regulatory DUR program compliance. Clinical pharmacists and UM staff contact the prescriber to resolve drug-drug interaction or d

attributes.name: prior_authorization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.prior_authorization. Business justification: DUR alerts capture pa_reference_number (STRING) and pa_required_flag (BOOLEAN), indicating that some DUR alerts trigger or reference a prior authorization requirement. Normalizing pa_reference_number

attributes.name: adjudication_outcome
attributes.description: Final adjudication outcome of the pharmacy claim after the DUR alert was processed. Indicates whether the claim was paid, rejected due to the alert, overridden by the pharmacist or plan, pending review, or reversed.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; CMS Part D; HIPAA EDI 835

attributes.name: alert_generated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the DUR alert was generated by the PBM adjudication engine (RxClaim or Argus) during real-time claim processing. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this record.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; CMS Part D DUR Reporting; RxClaim/Argus PBM System

attributes.name: alert_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the DUR alert record. 'active'=alert is open and requires action, 'resolved'=alert addressed and closed, 'overridden'=pharmacist or plan overrode the alert, 'suppressed'=alert suppressed per plan rules, 'escalated'=referred for clinical review.
attributes.references: NCPDP DUR/PPS Codes; CMS Part D DUR Reporting; URAC Pharmacy Benefit Management Standards

attributes.name: alert_type_code
attributes.description: NCPDP standardized code identifying the category of Drug Utilization Review (DUR) alert. Common values: DD=Drug-Drug Interaction, DC=Drug-Disease Contraindication, TD=Therapeutic Duplication, PA=Drug-Allergy, LD=Low Dose, HD=High Dose, MN=Drug-Age, CS=Drug-Gender, AD=Additive Toxicity, RF=Early Refill. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DD|DC|TD|PA|LD|HD|MN|CS|AD|RF|LR|DS|PG|MC|ID — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NCPDP DUR/PPS Codes; CMS Part D DUR Reporting; NCPDP Telecommunication Standard Field 439-E4

attributes.name: alert_type_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the DUR alert type (e.g., 'Drug-Drug Interaction', 'Therapeutic Duplication', 'High Dose Alert', 'Early Refill'). Complements the alert_type_code for reporting and member communications.
attributes.references: NCPDP DUR/PPS Codes; CMS Part D DUR Reporting

attributes.name: clinical_significance_code
attributes.description: Numeric code from the clinical drug database (First DataBank or Medi-Span) indicating the clinical significance of the drug interaction or contraindication. Ranges from 1 (most severe) to 5 (least severe). Supplements the NCPDP severity_level_code with database-specific grading.
attributes.references: First DataBank (FDB) Drug Interaction Database; Medi-Span Clinical Drug Information; NCPDP DUR Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the DUR alert record was first created and persisted in the data platform (Databricks Silver Layer). Represents the audit trail creation time, distinct from the business event timestamp (alert_generated_timestamp).
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312; CMS Part D Record Retention; NAIC Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: days_since_last_fill
attributes.description: Number of days elapsed since the member's last fill of the same or therapeutically equivalent drug. Key metric for early refill DUR alert generation and medication adherence analysis.
attributes.references: NCPDP DUR/PPS Codes; CMS Part D DUR Reporting; PBM Early Refill Policy

attributes.name: days_supply
attributes.description: Number of days of medication supply dispensed with the prescription. Used in early refill DUR calculations, quantity limit evaluations, and high-dose alert assessments.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard Field 405-D5; CMS Part D; PBM Formulary Management

attributes.name: dispensing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the drug was dispensed at the pharmacy. Used to correlate the DUR alert with the dispensing event and for retrospective DUR analysis and CMS Part D reporting.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard Field 401-D1; CMS Part D; HIPAA EDI 837P

attributes.name: drug_database_source
attributes.description: Identifies the clinical drug knowledge database used to generate the DUR alert (e.g., First DataBank (FDB), Medi-Span, Micromedex, Multum, or custom plan rules). Important for audit, reproducibility, and database version tracking.
attributes.references: First DataBank (FDB); Medi-Span; Micromedex; NCPDP DUR Standards; CMS Part D

attributes.name: drug_database_version
attributes.description: Version or effective date of the clinical drug knowledge database (e.g., FDB or Medi-Span) used at the time the DUR alert was generated. Required for audit trail and regulatory reproducibility of DUR alert decisions.
attributes.references: First DataBank (FDB); Medi-Span; CMS Part D DUR Reporting Requirements 42 CFR §423.153

attributes.name: drug_name
attributes.description: Brand or generic name of the primary drug (identified by drug_ndc) that triggered the DUR alert. Denormalized for reporting and pharmacist display without requiring a drug master join.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; First DataBank (FDB); Medi-Span Drug Database

attributes.name: drug_ndc
attributes.description: 11-digit National Drug Code (NDC) identifying the specific drug product (labeler, product, package) that triggered the DUR alert. Primary drug identifier used in pharmacy adjudication.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; NCPDP Telecommunication Standard Field 407-D7; CMS Part D

attributes.name: dur_program_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DUR alert was generated as part of a prospective (point-of-sale, real-time), retrospective (post-dispensing, claims analysis), or concurrent (during hospitalization or ongoing therapy) DUR program.
attributes.references: CMS Part D DUR Reporting Requirements 42 CFR §423.153; OBRA '90 DUR Requirements; URAC

attributes.name: icd_code_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases (ICD) Code Version
attributes.description: Version of the ICD coding system used for the icd_diagnosis_code on this DUR alert record (e.g., ICD-10-CM). Required for accurate clinical coding interpretation and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: WHO ICD Classification; CMS ICD-10 Mandate; HIPAA 45 CFR §162.1002

attributes.name: icd_diagnosis_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases (ICD) Diagnosis Code
attributes.description: ICD-10-CM diagnosis code associated with the drug-disease contraindication or drug-condition DUR alert. Identifies the member's condition that conflicts with the dispensed drug. Populated for DC (drug-disease) alert types.
attributes.references: WHO ICD-10-CM; CMS ICD-10 Implementation; HIPAA 45 CFR §162.1002

attributes.name: interacting_drug_name
attributes.description: Brand or generic name of the interacting drug involved in a drug-drug interaction or therapeutic duplication alert. Provides human-readable context for pharmacist review and DUR reporting without requiring a drug master lookup.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; First DataBank (FDB); Medi-Span Drug Database

attributes.name: interacting_drug_ndc
attributes.description: 11-digit NDC of the second drug involved in a drug-drug interaction (DDI) or therapeutic duplication DUR alert. Populated when alert_type_code indicates a drug-drug conflict. Null for non-interaction alert types.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; NCPDP DUR/PPS Codes; First DataBank (FDB) Drug Interaction Database

attributes.name: ncpdp_dur_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: NCPDP Drug Utilization Review (DUR) Conflict Code
attributes.description: Two-character NCPDP standardized DUR conflict code transmitted in the pharmacy claim transaction (Field 439-E4). Identifies the specific clinical conflict detected (e.g., 'DD' for drug-drug interaction). Required for CMS Part D DUR reporting.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard Field 439-E4; CMS Part D DUR Reporting Requirements 42 CFR §423.153

attributes.name: ncpdp_reject_code
attributes.description: Two-digit NCPDP reject code returned when the DUR alert results in a claim rejection (e.g., '88'=DUR Reject Error). Populated when adjudication_outcome is 'rejected'. Used for claim denial tracking and appeals.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard Reject Code List; CMS Part D; HIPAA EDI 835

attributes.name: override_code
attributes.description: Two-character NCPDP code submitted by the pharmacist to override a DUR alert and allow dispensing (e.g., 'OO'=Other Override, 'OP'=Prescriber Override, 'OR'=Pharmacist Override). Populated when adjudication_outcome is 'overridden'.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard Override Segment; CMS Part D DUR Reporting

attributes.name: override_comment
attributes.description: Free-text clinical justification or pharmacist notes entered when overriding a DUR alert. Documents the clinical rationale for proceeding with dispensing despite the alert. Supports audit and retrospective DUR review.
attributes.references: CMS Part D DUR Reporting Requirements 42 CFR §423.153; URAC Pharmacy Standards

attributes.name: pa_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DUR alert outcome requires a Prior Authorization (PA) to be obtained before the drug can be dispensed. True when the alert triggers a PA requirement per plan formulary or step therapy rules.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prior Authorization Requirements; NCPDP DUR/PPS Codes; URAC Pharmacy Standards

attributes.name: prescribed_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the drug as written on the original prescription by the prescriber. Compared against quantity_dispensed and plan quantity limits in DUR alert evaluation.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; State Board of Pharmacy Regulations; CMS Part D

attributes.name: prescription_written_date
attributes.description: Date the prescription was originally written by the prescriber. Used in early refill DUR alerts to calculate days since prescription was issued and validate refill timing.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard Field 414-DE; State Board of Pharmacy Regulations

attributes.name: professional_service_code
attributes.description: Two-character NCPDP code (Field 440-E5) indicating the professional service performed by the pharmacist in response to the DUR alert (e.g., 'AS'=Patient Assessment, 'CC'=Coordination of Care, 'DE'=Dosing Evaluation, 'PM'=Patient Medication Education). Required for CMS Part D DUR reporting.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard Field 440-E5; CMS Part D DUR Reporting Requirements 42 CFR §423.153

attributes.name: quantity_dispensed
attributes.description: Quantity of the drug dispensed (in units as defined by the drug's billing unit of measure). Used in high-dose and quantity limit DUR alert evaluations.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard Field 442-E7; CMS Part D; FDA Drug Labeling

attributes.name: quantity_limit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DUR alert was triggered by a quantity limit edit, where the dispensed or prescribed quantity exceeds the plan's maximum allowable quantity for the drug.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Quantity Limit Requirements; NCPDP DUR/PPS Codes; PBM Formulary Management

attributes.name: reason_for_service_code
attributes.description: Two-character NCPDP code (Field 439-E4 context) providing the clinical reason for the DUR service intervention. Captures the specific clinical basis for the alert and pharmacist action. Used in prospective DUR programs.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; CMS Part D DUR Reporting Requirements 42 CFR §423.153

attributes.name: refill_number
attributes.description: Sequential refill number for the prescription (0=original fill, 1=first refill, etc.). Used in early refill DUR alert logic to determine if the member is refilling too soon relative to the previous fill's days supply.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard Field 403-D3; State Board of Pharmacy Regulations

attributes.name: result_of_service_code
attributes.description: Two-character NCPDP code (Field 441-E6) indicating the outcome of the pharmacist's intervention in response to the DUR alert (e.g., 'FA'=Filled As Is, 'FN'=Filled with Prescriber Approval, 'FC'=Filled, Calling Prescriber, 'FD'=Filled, Directions Clarified). Required for CMS Part D DUR reporting.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard Field 441-E6; CMS Part D DUR Reporting Requirements 42 CFR §423.153

attributes.name: severity_level_code
attributes.description: Coded severity level of the DUR alert indicating clinical significance. Typically: 1=Contraindicated/Severe, 2=Major, 3=Moderate, 4=Minor, 5=Informational. Drives pharmacist override requirements and adjudication workflow.
attributes.references: NCPDP DUR/PPS Codes; First DataBank (FDB) Severity Levels; Medi-Span Drug Interaction Severity

attributes.name: severity_level_description
attributes.description: Plain-language description of the DUR alert severity level (e.g., 'Contraindicated', 'Major', 'Moderate', 'Minor', 'Informational'). Used in pharmacist-facing displays and DUR reporting dashboards.
attributes.references: NCPDP DUR/PPS Codes; First DataBank (FDB); Medi-Span

attributes.name: step_therapy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DUR alert is related to a step therapy protocol violation, where the member has not tried a required first-line drug before the prescribed drug. Supports step therapy enforcement and CMS Part D reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Step Therapy Requirements; NCPDP DUR/PPS Codes; PBM Formulary Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the DUR alert record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks updates such as status changes, override entries, or adjudication outcome revisions for audit and data lineage purposes.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312; CMS Part D Record Retention; NAIC Data Governance Standards

products.name: dispensing_pharmacy
products.description: Master record for retail, mail-order, and specialty pharmacies participating in the PBM network. Captures pharmacy identity: NPI, NCPDP provider ID, pharmacy name, chain/independent flag, pharmacy type (retail/mail/specialty/long-term care/compounding), address, phone, DEA number, state license. Captures network participation and contractual reimbursement terms: network tier (preferred/standard/specialty), network participation status, dispensing fee schedule, ingredient cost reimbursement basis (AWP discount/MAC/WAC), contract type (direct/PBM-administered), contract effective date range, performance requirements, audit provisions, mail-order fulfillment capabilities (cold chain certification, signature requirements), and per-pharmacy or per-chain contract variations. This is the SSOT for pharmacy provider identity, network participation, and all pharmacy-level reimbursement contract terms within the pharmacy domain; detailed credentialing lives in the provider/credential domains.

attributes.name: dispensing_pharmacy_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the dispensing pharmacy record within the PBM network master. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.account. Business justification: Dispensing pharmacies receive payment settlements (ingredient costs, dispensing fees) through billing accounts. Health insurance/PBM operations require linking each dispensing pharmacy to its billing

attributes.name: baa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.baa. Business justification: BAA management: each dispensing pharmacy must have a Business Associate Agreement for PHI handling; compliance tracks BAAs per pharmacy.

attributes.name: ncpdp_provider_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Council for Prescription Drug Programs (NCPDP) Provider ID
attributes.description: The 7-digit NCPDP pharmacy identifier (formerly NABP number) used as the primary pharmacy identifier in PBM claim transactions, formulary lookups, and pharmacy network directories. Sourced from RxClaim or Argus PBM system.
attributes.references: NCPDP Provider Identification Standard; CMS Part D; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: network_provider_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.network_provider. Business justification: A dispensing pharmacy participating in a provider network has a corresponding network_provider record capturing credentialing status, participation type, and directory listing. Pharmacy credentialing

attributes.name: pbm_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.pbm_contract. Business justification: Dispensing pharmacies operate under PBM contracts that govern their reimbursement rates (AWP discount, dispensing fees, MAC list), network participation terms, and performance guarantees. Linking disp

attributes.name: provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Internal pharmacy identifier assigned by the PBM system (RxClaim or Argus) for claim routing and adjudication. May differ from NCPDP ID in multi-PBM environments. Used for system-level reconciliation.
attributes.references: RxClaim/Argus PBM System; NCPDP Claim Adjudication Standard

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.provider_network. Business justification: Required for network participation reporting and CMS network adequacy; each pharmacy must be linked to the provider network it belongs to.

attributes.name: tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.tier. Business justification: Dispensing pharmacies are assigned to network tiers (preferred, standard, specialty) that determine member cost-sharing differentials. The plain attribute network_tier is a denormalized representation

attributes.name: accepts_electronic_prescriptions
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy is enabled to receive electronic prescriptions (e-prescribing) via NCPDP SCRIPT standard. Required for controlled substance e-prescribing (EPCS) compliance in many states.
attributes.references: NCPDP SCRIPT Standard; DEA EPCS Regulations 21 CFR Part 1311; State E-Prescribing Mandates

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the pharmacy dispensing location. Used for member pharmacy locator, network directory, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: NCPDP Provider Identification Standard; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address information (suite, unit, floor) for the pharmacy dispensing location.

attributes.name: awp_discount_percent
attributes.description: The contracted discount percentage applied to the AWP for brand drug ingredient cost reimbursement. For example, AWP minus 15% means awp_discount_percent = 15.00. Applies when ingredient_cost_basis is 'awp_discount'. Commercially sensitive contract term.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Reimbursement Standards; AWP Industry Benchmark; PBM Contract Standards

attributes.name: chain_independent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy is part of a chain organization (e.g., CVS, Walgreens, Rite Aid) or operates as an independent pharmacy. Affects contract terms, reimbursement rates, and network tier assignment.
attributes.references: NCPDP Pharmacy Chain/Independent Classification; PBM Contract Standards

attributes.name: chain_organization_name
attributes.description: Name of the parent chain organization if the pharmacy is a chain location (e.g., CVS Health, Walgreens Boots Alliance). Null for independent pharmacies. Used for chain-level contract management and performance reporting.
attributes.references: NCPDP Chain Code Standard; PBM Contract Management

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the pharmacy dispensing location. Used for geographic network analysis, member access reporting, and CMS Part D network adequacy compliance.
attributes.references: NCPDP Provider Identification Standard; CMS Part D Network Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: cold_chain_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy holds cold chain certification for temperature-sensitive drug storage and shipping (e.g., biologics, insulin, vaccines). Required for specialty and mail-order pharmacies dispensing refrigerated or frozen medications.
attributes.references: USP Chapter 1118; URAC Specialty Pharmacy Accreditation; CMS Part D Specialty Drug Standards

attributes.name: contract_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pharmacy's network participation contract becomes effective. Used to validate claim eligibility by service date and for contract lifecycle management.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Pharmacy Contract Requirements; PBM Contract Standards

attributes.name: contract_termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pharmacy's network participation contract ends or was terminated. Null for active open-ended contracts. Used for claim eligibility validation and network adequacy gap analysis.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Pharmacy Contract Requirements; PBM Contract Standards

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy reimbursement contract is negotiated directly with the health plan (direct) or administered through the PBM intermediary (PBM-administered). Affects financial settlement, audit rights, and MAC list applicability.
attributes.references: PBM Contract Standards; ERISA; CMS Part D Pharmacy Contract Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the dispensing pharmacy record was first created in the PBM network master. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory record retention requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; CMS Part D Record Retention Requirements; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_amount
attributes.description: The contracted per-prescription dispensing fee paid to the pharmacy in addition to ingredient cost reimbursement. Expressed in USD. May vary by pharmacy type, drug type, or days supply. Commercially sensitive contract term.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Dispensing Fee Standards; PBM Contract Standards; NCPDP Claim Adjudication

attributes.name: dispensing_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state code of the state in which the pharmacy is licensed to dispense. May differ from the physical address state for mail-order pharmacies licensed in multiple states. Used for state-level regulatory compliance and claim adjudication.
attributes.references: State Board of Pharmacy Regulations; NABP; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: doing_business_as_name
attributes.description: Trade name or DBA name under which the pharmacy operates if different from the legal business name. Used in member-facing directories and communications.

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number for the pharmacy dispensing location. Used for prior authorization transmissions, prescription transfers, and clinical communications.
attributes.references: NCPDP Provider Identification Standard; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164
