attributes.name: ingredient_cost_basis
attributes.description: The pricing benchmark used to calculate ingredient cost reimbursement for drug claims. AWP (Average Wholesale Price) discount is most common for brand drugs; MAC (Maximum Allowable Cost) applies to generics; WAC (Wholesale Acquisition Cost) and NADAC (National Average Drug Acquisition Cost) are alternative benchmarks. Sourced from PBM contract terms in RxClaim/Argus.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Reimbursement Standards; NCPDP Claim Adjudication; MAC/AWP/WAC Industry Standards

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The health insurance line of business for which this pharmacy network participation record applies. A pharmacy may have separate network records per LOB with different contract terms. Drives claim adjudication routing and formulary selection.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; Medicaid Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438; ACA Exchange Requirements

attributes.name: mail_order_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy is certified and operationally capable of fulfilling mail-order prescriptions (90-day supply, home delivery). Drives claim routing and member benefit design enforcement.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Mail Order Pharmacy Requirements; URAC Mail Service Pharmacy Accreditation

attributes.name: ncpdp_chain_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Council for Prescription Drug Programs (NCPDP) Chain Code
attributes.description: NCPDP-assigned 4-digit chain code identifying the pharmacy chain organization. Used for chain-level contract application and bulk reimbursement rate assignment in the PBM system.

attributes.name: network_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pharmacy's current network participation status became effective. Distinct from contract_effective_date; captures the most recent network status change date (e.g., reactivation after suspension).
attributes.references: CMS Part D Pharmacy Network Requirements; PBM Contract Standards

attributes.name: network_participation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the pharmacy's participation in the PBM network. Drives real-time claim adjudication eligibility checks in RxClaim/Argus. Active pharmacies are eligible to dispense covered drugs; inactive/terminated pharmacies are rejected at point-of-sale.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Pharmacy Network Requirements; NCQA Pharmacy Accreditation; PBM Contract Standards

attributes.name: network_termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pharmacy's network participation was or is scheduled to be terminated. Null for currently active network participants. Used for claim eligibility validation and network adequacy gap analysis.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Pharmacy Network Requirements; PBM Contract Standards

attributes.name: performance_audit_provision
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy contract includes audit provisions allowing the PBM or health plan to conduct on-site or desk audits of dispensing records, pricing, and compliance. Required for CMS Part D sponsor oversight obligations.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Audit Requirements 42 CFR Part 423; PBM Contract Standards; ERISA

attributes.name: pharmacy_name
attributes.description: Legal business name of the dispensing pharmacy as registered with the state board of pharmacy and NCPDP. Used in member-facing communications, EOB documents, and provider directory.
attributes.references: NCPDP Provider Identification Standard; State Board of Pharmacy

attributes.name: pharmacy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pharmacy by dispensing channel and operational model. Drives claim routing, reimbursement logic, and formulary applicability within the PBM system (RxClaim/Argus). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: retail|mail_order|specialty|long_term_care|compounding — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: NCPDP Pharmacy Type Codes; CMS Part D Pharmacy Type Classification; PBM Industry Standard

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the pharmacy dispensing location. Used for member contact, prior authorization coordination, and provider directory.

attributes.name: signature_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy requires patient or authorized representative signature upon delivery for mail-order or specialty drug shipments. Relevant for controlled substances and high-value specialty medications.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301; CMS Part D Delivery Requirements; NCPDP Claim Adjudication

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational source system from which this pharmacy record was ingested (e.g., RxClaim, Argus PBM, Cactus credentialing system). Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation in the Databricks lakehouse Silver layer.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; Databricks Lakehouse Architecture

attributes.name: specialty_accreditation_code
attributes.description: Accreditation body certification held by the pharmacy for specialty drug dispensing. URAC, ACHC, and NABP PCAB are the primary specialty pharmacy accreditation bodies recognized by health plans and PBMs. Required for specialty network participation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: urac|achc|jcaho|nabp_pcab|none — promote to reference product if multi-accreditation tracking is needed]
attributes.references: URAC Specialty Pharmacy Accreditation Standards; ACHC Specialty Pharmacy Standards; NABP PCAB; CMS Part D Specialty Pharmacy Requirements

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the pharmacy dispensing location. Used for state-level licensure validation, network adequacy reporting, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviation Standard; NCPDP Provider Identification Standard; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: twenty_four_hour_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy operates 24 hours per day, 7 days per week. Used for network adequacy reporting and member access analysis, particularly for CMS Part D access requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Network Adequacy Standards; State DOI Network Adequacy Regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the dispensing pharmacy record was most recently updated. Used for change data capture, data quality monitoring, and audit trail in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; CMS Part D Record Retention Requirements; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: US ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the pharmacy dispensing location. Used for geographic network adequacy analysis, member proximity calculations, and CMS Part D access reporting.
attributes.references: USPS ZIP Code Standard; CMS Part D Network Adequacy; NCPDP Provider Identification Standard

products.name: pbm_contract
products.description: Master record for PBM (Pharmacy Benefit Manager) contracts governing the relationship between the health plan and the PBM (e.g., RxClaim, Argus). Captures contract name, PBM vendor, contract type (ASO/full-risk/carve-out), effective date range, rebate guarantee terms, dispensing fee schedules, MAC list reference, performance guarantees, audit rights, and LOB scope. This is the SSOT for PBM contractual terms within the pharmacy domain.

attributes.name: pbm_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the PBM contract record in the pharmacy domain silver layer. Primary key for this entity. Role: MASTER_AGREEMENT.

attributes.name: billing_cycle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.cycle. Business justification: PBM rebate reconciliation and settlement are governed by billing cycle schedules. Health insurance operations require linking PBM contracts to the billing cycle that controls rebate settlement frequen

attributes.name: delegation_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.delegation_agreement. Business justification: CMS and NCQA require health plans to maintain formal delegation agreements when PBM functions (formulary management, PA, UM) are delegated. Linking pbm_contract to delegation_agreement supports oversi

attributes.name: fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.fee_schedule. Business justification: PBM contract pricing terms (dispensing fees, AWP discount percentages) are formally codified in fee schedules. Contract management and finance teams require this link to associate PBM pricing commitme

attributes.name: formulary_id
attributes.description: Reference to the drug formulary associated with this PBM contract. The formulary defines covered drugs, tier assignments, and utilization management rules governed by this contract.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Requirements; 42 CFR Part 423; NCQA

attributes.name: group_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to employer.group. Business justification: In self-funded and ASO employer arrangements, PBM contracts are negotiated at the employer group level. This link supports PBM contract administration reporting, renewal tracking, and pharmacy benefit

attributes.name: provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract_provider_contract. Business justification: PBM contracts are executed under a master provider contract framework. Contract management teams must trace PBM agreements to the governing provider contract for amendment tracking, regulatory filings

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.provider_network. Business justification: PBM contracts define pharmacy benefit terms (AWP discounts, dispensing fees, MAC lists) for a specific pharmacy provider network. Health plan operations require linking PBM contracts to the network th

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Regulatory obligations tied to PBM contracts; compliance team records which obligations each contract must satisfy.

attributes.name: um_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to utilization.um_program. Business justification: PBM contracts delegate specific UM program functions (PA, step therapy, DUR, quantity limits) to the PBM. pbm_contract has prior_auth_flag, step_therapy_flag, dur_program_flag. FK to um_program suppor

attributes.name: amendment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent amendment or addendum executed against this PBM contract. Null if no amendments have been made since original execution. Used to track contract evolution and ensure current terms are applied in adjudication.
attributes.references: ERISA; NAIC; Internal Contract Management Policy

attributes.name: audit_frequency
attributes.description: Contractually specified frequency at which the health plan may exercise audit rights over the PBM. Relevant only when audit_rights_flag is True. Drives compliance calendar and vendor oversight scheduling.
attributes.references: ERISA; CMS Part D; NAIC; State DOI Audit Requirements

attributes.name: audit_rights_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the health plan has contractual audit rights to inspect PBM financial records, rebate calculations, MAC list pricing, and claims adjudication data. True = audit rights granted; False = not included. Critical for compliance and financial oversight.
attributes.references: ERISA; HIPAA; CMS Part D; NAIC; State DOI Audit Requirements

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the PBM contract automatically renews at the end of the contract term unless notice of termination is provided. True = auto-renews; False = requires affirmative renewal action.

attributes.name: cms_contract_number
attributes.description: CMS (Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services) contract number associated with the Medicare Part D plan under which this PBM contract operates (e.g., H1234 for MA-PD, S1234 for PDP). Required for CMS Part D reporting and RAPS/EDPS submissions. Null for non-Medicare LOBs.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; 42 CFR Part 423; CMS HPMS

attributes.name: contract_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the PBM contract (e.g., 'Express Scripts ASO Agreement FY2024'). Used for display in reporting dashboards and contract management workflows.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable contract reference number assigned by the health plan or PBM vendor at execution. Used for correspondence, audits, and regulatory filings. Maps to the contract identifier in RxClaim or Argus PBM system.
attributes.references: ERISA; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: contract_owner_name
attributes.description: Name of the health plan employee or department responsible for managing this PBM contract relationship. Used for escalation routing, audit coordination, and vendor governance.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the PBM contract. Draft indicates the contract is under negotiation; active indicates it is in force; suspended indicates temporarily halted; terminated indicates early cancellation; expired indicates natural end-of-term; pending_renewal indicates renewal is in progress.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Internal Contract Lifecycle Policy

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the PBM contract arrangement. ASO (Administrative Services Only) means the health plan retains financial risk; full_risk means the PBM assumes drug spend risk; carve_out means pharmacy benefits are separated from medical; pass_through means drug costs are passed at actual cost; hybrid combines elements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ASO|full_risk|carve_out|pass_through|hybrid — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: ERISA; CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual; NAIC

attributes.name: contract_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the PBM contract document, incremented with each amendment or renewal (e.g., '1.0', '2.1', 'Amendment_3'). Supports contract lifecycle management and audit trail for regulatory examinations.
attributes.references: ERISA; NAIC; Internal Contract Management Policy

attributes.name: dur_program_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Drug Utilization Review (DUR) — including prospective, concurrent, and retrospective DUR — is included as a service under this PBM contract. True = DUR services included; False = not included.
attributes.references: OBRA 1990; CMS Part D; NCQA; URAC

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the PBM contract becomes legally binding and operationally active. Governs when PBM services, pricing schedules, and rebate guarantees take effect. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: ERISA; CMS Part D; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164

attributes.name: generic_dispensing_rate_guarantee
attributes.description: Contractually guaranteed minimum generic dispensing rate (GDR) as a percentage of total prescription claims. If the PBM fails to achieve this rate, financial penalties or credits apply. Key cost-management metric in PBM contracts.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NCQA HEDIS; Internal PBM Performance Standards

attributes.name: governing_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the state whose laws govern this PBM contract for dispute resolution and regulatory compliance purposes. Relevant for state DOI oversight, MAC transparency laws, and PBM regulation.
attributes.references: NAIC; State DOI Regulations; State PBM Transparency Laws

attributes.name: ingredient_cost_basis
attributes.description: The drug pricing benchmark used as the basis for ingredient cost reimbursement under this contract. AWP (Average Wholesale Price), WAC (Wholesale Acquisition Cost), MAC (Maximum Allowable Cost), NADAC (National Average Drug Acquisition Cost), or AAC (Actual Acquisition Cost). Determines the reimbursement formula for drug ingredient costs.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NAIC; AWP/WAC Industry Standards; 42 CFR Part 423

attributes.name: lob_scope
attributes.description: Line of Business (LOB) covered under this PBM contract. Determines which member populations and benefit programs are governed by this agreement. A single contract may cover one or multiple LOBs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commercial|medicare_part_d|medicaid|exchange|all — promote to reference product for multi-LOB support]
attributes.references: CMS Part D; ACA; NAIC; 42 CFR Part 423

attributes.name: mac_list_reference
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the MAC (Maximum Allowable Cost) list applied under this PBM contract for generic and multi-source drug reimbursement. MAC lists cap reimbursement for generics below AWP. References the specific MAC list version maintained by the PBM.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NAIC MAC Transparency Laws; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: mail_order_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether mail-order pharmacy dispensing services are included in the scope of this PBM contract. True = mail order included; False = retail-only or carved out.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NCQA; Internal PBM Contract Terms

attributes.name: mail_order_penetration_guarantee
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mail Order Penetration Rate Guarantee Percentage
attributes.description: Contractually guaranteed minimum mail-order pharmacy utilization rate as a percentage of eligible maintenance drug claims. Drives cost savings through mail-order channel incentives.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; Internal PBM Performance Standards

attributes.name: performance_guarantee_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the PBM contract includes financial performance guarantees (e.g., generic dispensing rate, mail-order penetration, member satisfaction scores). True = performance guarantees included; False = not included.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NCQA; URAC; Internal PBM Contract Terms

attributes.name: prior_auth_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether prior authorization (PA) requirements for specialty and non-formulary drugs are administered by the PBM under this contract. True = PBM manages PA; False = health plan manages PA internally.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NCQA; URAC; 42 CFR Part 423

attributes.name: quantity_limit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether quantity limit (QL) utilization management rules are in scope under this PBM contract. Quantity limits restrict the amount of a drug dispensed per fill or per time period. True = quantity limits apply; False = not applicable.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NCQA; URAC; Internal UM Policy

attributes.name: rebate_guarantee_pmpm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rebate Guarantee Per Member Per Month (PMPM)
attributes.description: Contractually guaranteed minimum rebate amount expressed as Per Member Per Month (PMPM) in USD that the PBM must remit to the health plan. A key financial performance guarantee in PBM contracts. Used for actuarial reserving and financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual; ERISA; GAAP; SAP

attributes.name: rebate_pass_through_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of manufacturer drug rebates that the PBM is contractually obligated to pass through to the health plan (e.g., 100% pass-through vs. spread-based retention). Critical for MLR (Medical Loss Ratio) calculations and CMS Part D compliance.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; ACA MLR Regulations 45 CFR Part 158; ERISA

attributes.name: rebate_reconciliation_lag_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days after the close of a settlement period within which the PBM must provide rebate invoices and supporting data to the health plan. Used for financial close scheduling and IBNR reserve calculations.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; GAAP; SAP; Internal Finance Policy

attributes.name: rebate_settlement_frequency
attributes.description: Contractually specified frequency at which the PBM remits drug manufacturer rebates to the health plan. Drives cash flow forecasting, accounts receivable management, and actuarial IBNR (Incurred But Not Reported) rebate estimates.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; GAAP; SAP; Internal Finance Policy

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PBM contract record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with HIPAA record retention requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; NAIC; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PBM contract record was most recently modified in the data platform. Supports change detection, SCD (Slowly Changing Dimension) processing, and audit trail requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; NAIC; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days prior to contract termination_date by which either party must provide written notice of intent not to renew. Operationally critical for contract management and vendor transitions.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational source system from which this PBM contract record was ingested into the lakehouse silver layer (e.g., RxClaim, Argus, manual entry). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164

attributes.name: specialty_pharmacy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether specialty pharmacy benefit management (high-cost biologics, specialty injectables) is within the scope of this PBM contract. True = specialty pharmacy included; False = carved out or not applicable.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NCQA; URAC; Internal Specialty Pharmacy Policy

attributes.name: step_therapy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether step therapy protocols are included in the scope of this PBM contract. Step therapy requires members to try lower-cost drugs before coverage of higher-cost alternatives is authorized. True = step therapy applies; False = not applicable.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NCQA; State Step Therapy Laws; URAC

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the PBM contract ends or was terminated. Null for open-ended contracts. Distinguishes between scheduled expiration and early termination when combined with contract_status. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: ERISA; CMS Part D; NAIC Model Regulation

domains.name: billing

products.name: payment_allocation
products.description: Association and reconciliation entity linking premium payments to invoice lines, tracking line-level allocation, and managing periodic premium reconciliation outcomes. For allocation: captures allocated amount, allocation date, allocation type (standard, partial, overpayment, suspense resolution), and line-level reconciliation status. Supports many-to-many payment-to-invoice matching and enables accurate accounts receivable aging. For periodic reconciliation: captures reconciliation period, total billed, total collected, total adjustments, variance amount, variance reason, reconciliation status (open, in review, approved, closed), approver reference, and reconciliation type (monthly, quarterly, annual). Supports MLR calculation inputs, financial close processes, CMS premium reconciliation, and end-to-end premium reconciliation from individual line-level allocation through period-level summary and variance analysis. SSOT for all payment allocation and premium reconciliation in the billing domain.

domains.name: utilization
domains.description: Manages utilization management (UM) and prior authorization (PA) workflows — inpatient concurrent review, retrospective review, medical necessity determination, peer-to-peer processes, and UM turnaround time compliance. Owns PA requests, clinical criteria application (InterQual, MCG), authorization decisions, length-of-stay benchmarks, and denial reasons. Supports NCQA UM accreditation standards and state PA reform mandates. Source system: InterQual or MCG.
domains.references: NCQA UM Standards, CMS, State DOI, State PA Reform Laws

products.name: pa_request
products.description: Core master entity representing a prior authorization (PA) request submitted by a provider or member for a proposed service, procedure, drug, or admission. Captures requesting provider NPI, member ID, requested service codes (CPT/HCPCS/ICD), urgency type (standard, expedited, urgent), submission channel (portal, fax, phone, EDI 278), submission timestamp, current PA status, and full status transition history. Also tracks additional information requests (AIRs) issued during review — information type requested, requested-from party, due date, received date, and TAT clock extension impact. Authoritative SSOT for all PA requests, their status lifecycle, and associated documentation requests.

products.name: pa_decision
products.description: Transactional record capturing the authorization decision and underlying medical necessity determination rendered on a PA request. Stores decision date, decision type (approved, denied, partially approved, pended, withdrawn), clinical criteria applied (InterQual/MCG criteria set, version, effective date), criteria met/not met flag, clinical rationale narrative, ICD diagnosis codes supporting the determination, deciding reviewer NPI and credentials (MD, RN, PharmD), denial reason code and category (medical necessity, administrative, benefit exclusion, out-of-network, experimental/investigational), denial regulatory citation, appeal eligibility flag, and effective authorization period (start/end dates). Each PA request may have one or more decision records reflecting amendments, P2P reversals, or appeal overrides. Serves as the single evidentiary record for NCQA audits, state DOI market conduct exams, and denial defense.

products.name: reviewer_program_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the formal Assignment between um_reviewer and um_program. It captures the authorization of a qualified UM reviewer to conduct reviews under a specific UM program, as required by NCQA and URAC accreditation standards. Each record links one um_reviewer to one um_program and carries the effective dates and role of the assignment — data that exists only in the context of this reviewer-program authorization and is essential for compliance auditing and accreditation documentation.. Existence Justification: In health insurance UM operations, reviewers are formally assigned to specific UM programs based on their credentials, specialty, and licensure — a single reviewer (e.g., an RN with oncology specialty) may be authorized under multiple UM programs (e.g., inpatient UM and specialty drug UM), and each UM program requires multiple qualified reviewers to meet NCQA/URAC staffing standards. This assignment is an actively managed, compliance-critical business concept: health plans must document which reviewers are authorized under which programs, with effective dates, to satisfy accreditation audits. The relationship carries its own data (assignment start/end dates, reviewer role within the program) that belongs to neither the reviewer nor the program alone.

However, if the business treats assigned_review_queue as the reviewer's primary/default queue independent of program context, it may remain on um_reviewer. products.name: team_enrollment_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the Assignment between care.team and care.care_enrollment. It captures the operational record of a multi-disciplinary care team being assigned to manage a specific member care enrollment, including the assignment lifecycle (dates, status) and the team's functional role for that enrollment. Each record links one team to one care enrollment with attributes that exist only in the context of this assignment relationship. Supports NCQA care management standards and CMS chronic care management (CCM) billing requirements for documented team-based care.. Existence Justification: In care management operations, multi-disciplinary care teams are actively assigned to member care enrollments as a managed business process. One team can serve many enrolled members simultaneously (e.g., a behavioral health team managing 50 enrolled members), and one enrolled member can be served by multiple teams concurrently (e.g., a primary care team plus a behavioral health team plus a complex care team). This team-enrollment assignment is a recognized operational entity in care management platforms like Casenet TruCare, carrying its own lifecycle data including assignment dates, status, and role that cannot be stored on either parent entity alone.

products.name: plan_association
products.description: Association entity linking a provider network to one or more health plan products, capturing the effective period, LOB, market segment (individual, small group, large group, Medicare, Medicaid), and whether the network is the primary or supplemental network for that plan. Enables plan-to-network resolution for eligibility verification (270/271 EDI) and claims adjudication routing. Owned by the network domain as the structural bridge between network configurations and plan offerings.

attributes.name: plan_association_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the plan association record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the health plan product that is associated with this provider network. Links to the plan and benefit domain's plan entity.

attributes.name: network_service_area_id
attributes.description: Reference to the geographic service area where this plan-network association is valid. Defines the counties, ZIP codes, or regions where members can access this network under this plan.

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider network being associated with the health plan product. Links to the network domain's network configuration entity.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws - Network Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.tier. Business justification: plan_association has a network_tier STRING column that captures the tier designation for the plan-network association. The tier table is the authoritative reference for tier definitions within a provi

attributes.name: aco_participation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan-network association includes participation in an Accountable Care Organization arrangement. True means ACO providers are included in this network for this plan; false means no ACO participation.

attributes.name: adequacy_certification_date
attributes.description: The date when this plan-network association was certified as meeting network adequacy requirements by the regulatory authority or internal compliance review.

attributes.name: adequacy_review_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent network adequacy review or assessment for this plan-network association. Used to track compliance monitoring cycles.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws - Network Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: association_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for this plan-to-network association, used in eligibility verification (270/271 EDI transactions) and claims adjudication routing.

attributes.name: association_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name for this plan-to-network association, typically combining plan name and network name for operational reference.

attributes.name: association_type
attributes.description: Classification of the network's role for this plan. Primary indicates the main network for member access; supplemental provides additional coverage; specialty covers specific service categories; out-of-area supports members outside primary service area; reciprocal represents shared network arrangements; tertiary provides fallback coverage.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws - Network Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: auto_assignment_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members can be automatically assigned to providers in this network under this plan. True means eligible for auto-assignment; false means member must actively select.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference to the master contract or agreement document that governs this plan-network association. Links to contract management systems for terms, rates, and legal provisions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this plan-network association record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: directory_publication_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers in this network for this plan should be published in member-facing provider directories and online search tools. True means include in directory; false means exclude (e.g., for internal or specialty networks).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this plan-to-network association becomes active and members can begin accessing providers in this network under this plan.

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: The line of business this plan-network association serves. Commercial covers employer-sponsored and individual plans; Medicare includes Medicare Advantage; Medicaid covers state programs; Marketplace represents ACA exchange plans; dual eligible serves Medicare-Medicaid beneficiaries; CHIP covers Children's Health Insurance Program.

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: The market segment this plan-network association targets. Individual covers direct-to-consumer; small group typically 2-50 employees; large group 51-999 employees; jumbo group 1000+ employees; government includes federal and state employee plans; student covers university and college plans.

attributes.name: member_count
attributes.description: The number of members currently enrolled in this plan who have access to this network. Used for network adequacy calculations and capacity planning.

attributes.name: network_adequacy_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan-network association meets regulatory network adequacy standards for provider access, time-and-distance requirements, and specialty coverage. Compliant meets all standards; non-compliant fails requirements; under review is being evaluated; exempt has regulatory waiver; conditional meets standards with restrictions.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or contextual information about this plan-network association. Used for operational notes that do not fit structured fields.

attributes.name: out_of_network_coverage_flag

attributes.name: pcp_selection_required_flag

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required_flag

attributes.name: referral_required_flag

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.description: Indicates whether provider performance in this network impacts the plan's CMS Star Ratings. Applicable primarily to Medicare Advantage plans. True means network performance affects Star metrics; false means no Star impact.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date when this plan-to-network association ends. Null indicates an open-ended association. After this date, members can no longer access providers in this network under this plan for new services.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: The user identifier or system account that last modified this plan-network association record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: vbc_arrangement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan-network association operates under a value-based care payment model. True means providers in this network are reimbursed based on quality and outcomes; false means traditional fee-for-service.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user identifier or system account that created this plan-network association record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: adequacy_standard
products.description: Reference entity defining all network compliance standards by specialty, facility type, and geographic area — encompassing time-distance standards (e.g., 30 miles/30 minutes for PCPs), provider-to-member ratios, appointment access wait-time standards (routine, urgent, preventive, behavioral health), after-hours availability requirements, and telehealth equivalency rules. Captures regulatory source (CMS, state DOI, NCQA, URAC), standard category (time-distance, provider-ratio, appointment-access, after-hours, telehealth-equivalency), specialty category, geographic classification (urban, suburban, rural, frontier), maximum wait time in days, threshold values, and after-hours availability flag. This is the single source of truth for all network adequacy and access compliance standards — both geographic access (time-distance, ratios) and appointment access (wait times, after-hours). Used to evaluate compliance in adequacy assessments, access surveys, and CMS/state regulatory filings.
products.reference: CMS Network Adequacy Time-Distance Standards — 42 CFR 438.68

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, clarifications, or special instructions related to this adequacy standard. May include implementation guidance, historical context, or regulatory interpretation.

attributes.name: penalty_for_non_compliance
attributes.description: Description of regulatory penalties or consequences for failing to meet this standard (e.g., corrective action plan, fines, enrollment suspension, Star rating impact). Null if no specific penalty defined.
attributes.references: CMS Enforcement Actions, State DOI Sanctions

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Type of health plan this standard applies to: HMO (Health Maintenance Organization), PPO (Preferred Provider Organization), EPO (Exclusive Provider Organization), POS (Point of Service), HDHP (High Deductible Health Plan), or all (applies to all plan types). Standards may vary by plan structure.
attributes.references: CMS Plan Type Definitions, NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: provider_to_member_ratio
attributes.description: Required ratio of providers to members for this specialty and geography, expressed as ratio string (e.g., 1:2000 for PCPs, 1:5000 for specialists). Null if standard is not ratio-based.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Provider Ratio Standards, NCQA Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_source
attributes.description: Governing body or regulatory authority that mandates this standard: CMS (Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services), state-DOI (State Department of Insurance), NCQA (National Committee for Quality Assurance), URAC, ACA (Affordable Care Act), or internal (company-defined standard exceeding regulatory minimums).
attributes.references: CMS, State DOI, NCQA, URAC, ACA

attributes.name: service_area_type
attributes.description: Geographic unit for which this standard is defined: county (county-level), zip (ZIP code level), state (state-wide), region (multi-state region), or national (nationwide standard).

attributes.name: specialty_category
attributes.description: Provider specialty or facility type this standard applies to (e.g., PCP, cardiology, behavioral-health, hospital, SNF, DME). May be broad category or specific specialty code.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Taxonomy, AMA Specialty Codes

attributes.name: standard_category
attributes.description: Classification of the adequacy standard type: time-distance (geographic access), provider-ratio (provider-to-member ratios), appointment-access (wait time standards), after-hours (availability requirements), telehealth-equivalency (virtual care standards), or network-composition (network mix requirements).
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, NCQA Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: standard_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the adequacy standard (e.g., PCP_URBAN_TIME, BH_RURAL_RATIO). Used for external reference and reporting.

attributes.name: standard_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the adequacy standard (e.g., Primary Care Physician Urban Time-Distance Standard).

attributes.name: standard_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for this standard, used to track changes over time (e.g., 2024.1, v3.0). Supports historical analysis and regulatory audit trails.

attributes.name: telehealth_equivalency_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether telehealth/virtual care providers can be counted toward meeting this adequacy standard. True if telehealth equivalency is permitted, false if only in-person providers count.
attributes.references: CMS Telehealth Policy, State DOI Telehealth Parity Laws

attributes.name: telehealth_percentage_cap
attributes.description: Maximum percentage of the adequacy requirement that can be met through telehealth providers (e.g., 25.00 means up to 25% of required providers can be telehealth-only). Null if no cap or telehealth not allowed.
attributes.references: CMS Telehealth Policy, State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when this adequacy standard is no longer in effect, either due to regulatory change or supersession by a new standard. Null if currently active with no planned end date.
attributes.references: CMS Regulatory Updates, State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: threshold_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of members or geographic area that must meet this standard (e.g., 90.00 means 90% of members must have access within the specified time/distance). Used for compliance measurement.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State DOI Requirements

products.name: adequacy_assessment
products.description: Transactional record of a network compliance evaluation — including network adequacy assessments, access surveys, mystery shopper studies, and gap identification. Captures assessment type (adequacy, access-survey, mystery-shopper), assessment date, regulatory submission type (CMS, state DOI), specialty/facility type evaluated, provider counts, member-to-provider ratios, time-distance compliance results, wait-time measurements, survey method (member survey, secret shopper call), appointment type requested, telehealth offered flag, and overall compliance outcome. Includes detail-level gap findings as child records: specific specialty or facility type shortfalls within a geographic area, gap severity, number of providers available vs. required, remediation actions taken, and resolution status. Supports CMS network adequacy filings, NCQA HEDIS access measures (Getting Care Quickly), CAHPS survey supplementation, and targeted network development. This is the SSOT for all network compliance evaluations and their associated gap findings.
products.reference: CMS Network Adequacy Filing — HPMS Submission

attributes.name: access_standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.access_standard. Business justification: adequacy_assessment evaluates both network adequacy (via adequacy_standard_id) and appointment access/availability compliance. The access_standard table defines appointment wait-time and availability

attributes.name: adequacy_standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.adequacy_standard. Business justification: Each adequacy assessment applies a specific adequacy standard; linking via adequacy_standard_id enables reference to the standard definition.

attributes.name: benefit_package_id

attributes.description: Identifier of the health plan associated with this network adequacy assessment.

attributes.name: network_service_area_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the geographic service area evaluated in this assessment.

attributes.name: provider_contract_id

attributes.name: provider_network_id

attributes.name: accepting_new_patients_flag

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the network adequacy assessment was conducted or completed.

attributes.name: assessment_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the adequacy assessment, used for external reference and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: assessment_period_end_date

attributes.name: assessment_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the evaluation period covered by this assessment.

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Type of network compliance evaluation performed: adequacy (provider count and ratio), access-survey (member experience survey), mystery-shopper (secret shopper call study), gap-analysis (deficiency identification), time-distance (geographic access compliance), or appointment-availability (wait time measurement).

attributes.name: assessor_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or team responsible for conducting the network adequacy assessment.

attributes.name: assessor_organization
attributes.description: Organization or department that conducted the assessment (e.g., internal network management team, third-party consultant, regulatory auditor).

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional notes, observations, or context related to the network adequacy assessment, including qualitative findings or special circumstances.

attributes.name: compliance_outcome
attributes.description: Overall compliance result of the network adequacy assessment: compliant (meets all standards), non-compliant (fails standards), partially-compliant (meets some but not all standards), under-review (pending final determination), or remediation-required (corrective action needed).

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: facility_type

attributes.name: gap_identified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether network gaps or deficiencies were identified during the assessment. True if gaps exist, False otherwise.

attributes.name: gap_severity
attributes.description: Severity level of identified network gaps: critical (immediate member access risk), high (significant access limitation), moderate (minor access concern), or low (minimal impact).

attributes.name: member_to_provider_ratio
attributes.description: Calculated ratio of enrolled members to available providers in the assessed specialty or facility type, expressed as members per provider.

attributes.name: provider_count_available
attributes.description: Number of in-network providers or facilities available in the assessed specialty or facility type within the service area.

attributes.name: provider_count_required
attributes.description: Minimum number of providers or facilities required by regulatory standards to meet network adequacy thresholds for the assessed specialty or facility type.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_type
attributes.description: Type of regulatory body or framework for which this assessment is being conducted: CMS Medicare, CMS Marketplace, State Department of Insurance (DOI), NCQA accreditation, internal monitoring, or ACA Qualified Health Plan (QHP) certification.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Requirements, State DOI Regulations, NCQA Standards, ACA Section 1311

attributes.name: remediation_action_taken
attributes.description: Description of corrective actions taken to address identified network gaps, such as provider recruitment, contract expansion, telehealth deployment, or member outreach.

attributes.name: remediation_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which remediation actions must be completed to resolve identified network gaps and achieve compliance.
attributes.references: CMS Corrective Action Plan Requirements, State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: remediation_status
attributes.description: Current status of remediation efforts: not-started (action plan pending), in-progress (corrective actions underway), completed (actions finished), verified (compliance confirmed), or overdue (past due date).

attributes.name: specialty_type
attributes.description: Medical specialty or provider type being evaluated in this assessment (e.g., primary care, cardiology, orthopedics, behavioral health, pediatrics).
attributes.references: AMA Physician Specialty Codes, CMS Provider Taxonomy

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the network adequacy assessment was submitted to the regulatory body (CMS, State DOI, NCQA).
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Filing Deadlines, State DOI Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: submission_status
attributes.description: Status of the regulatory submission: draft (not yet submitted), submitted (under review), accepted (approved by regulator), rejected (not approved), or resubmission-required (corrections needed).
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Filing Process, State DOI Submission Standards

attributes.name: survey_method
attributes.description: Methodology used to conduct the assessment: member survey (CAHPS or custom), secret shopper call (mystery shopper study), provider survey (direct provider inquiry), administrative data (claims and enrollment analysis), or geospatial analysis (GIS mapping).
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications, CAHPS Survey Protocol

attributes.name: telehealth_offered_flag

attributes.name: time_distance_compliance_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of members in the service area who have access to the assessed provider specialty or facility type within the required time and distance standards.

attributes.name: time_distance_standard_miles

attributes.name: time_distance_standard_minutes

attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Time and Distance Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the adequacy assessment record was last modified in the system.

attributes.description: Average number of days members wait for a routine appointment with the assessed provider specialty, measured through survey or mystery shopper methodology.

products.name: adequacy_gap
products.description: Captures individual network adequacy gaps identified during an adequacy assessment — specific specialty or facility type shortfalls within a geographic area that fail to meet the applicable adequacy standard. Records gap type, affected specialty, geographic area, number of providers available vs. required, gap severity, remediation action taken (e.g., provider recruitment, access plan exception), and resolution status. Enables targeted network development and regulatory gap closure tracking.

attributes.description: Actual date on which this adequacy gap was resolved and the network met the applicable adequacy standard. Null if gap remains unresolved.

attributes.name: affected_member_count
attributes.description: Estimated number of plan members residing in the affected geographic area who are impacted by this adequacy gap.

attributes.name: available_provider_count
attributes.description: Number of providers or facilities of the specified type currently available in the network in this geographic area. Null if standard is not count-based.

attributes.name: exception_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory exception or access plan waiver was approved by CMS or the state DOI. Null if no exception has been granted.

attributes.name: exception_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the granted regulatory exception or access plan waiver expires and the network must meet the full adequacy standard. Null if no exception has been granted or if exception is permanent.

attributes.name: exception_granted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a regulatory exception or access plan waiver has been granted by CMS or the state DOI for this adequacy gap.

attributes.name: exception_justification
attributes.description: Business rationale and supporting documentation for the regulatory exception or access plan waiver request (e.g., rural area with limited provider availability, specialty shortage area designation, alternative access arrangements).

attributes.name: exception_request_date
attributes.description: Date on which a regulatory exception or access plan waiver was formally requested for this adequacy gap. Null if no exception has been requested.

attributes.name: exception_requested_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a regulatory exception or access plan waiver has been requested from CMS or the state DOI for this adequacy gap.

attributes.name: gap_magnitude
attributes.description: Numeric difference between required and available provider count (required minus available). Positive values indicate shortfall. Null if standard is not count-based.

attributes.name: gap_number

attributes.name: gap_severity

attributes.name: gap_status

attributes.name: gap_type

attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, NAIC Model Act #74

attributes.name: geographic_area_code

attributes.references: U.S. Census Bureau FIPS Codes, USPS ZIP Codes

attributes.name: geographic_area_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the geographic area affected by this adequacy gap (e.g., county name, city name, region name).

attributes.name: geographic_area_type

attributes.name: identified_date

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes, context, or commentary regarding this adequacy gap, remediation efforts, or regulatory interactions.

attributes.name: plan_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which this adequacy gap applies and must be remediated (e.g., 2024, 2025). Network adequacy is assessed and certified annually.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, ACA Section 1311

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_required_flag

attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, ACA Section 1311, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: remediation_action
attributes.description: Description of the corrective action plan or strategy being implemented to close this adequacy gap (e.g., targeted provider recruitment, contract expansion, telehealth deployment, access plan exception request).
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: remediation_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual, team, or department responsible for executing the remediation action and closing this adequacy gap.

attributes.name: required_provider_count
attributes.description: Number of providers or facilities of the specified type required to meet the adequacy standard in this geographic area. Null if standard is not count-based.

attributes.name: specialty_code
attributes.description: Standard taxonomy code for the provider specialty or facility type that is deficient (e.g., NUCC taxonomy code for specialty providers, facility type code for facilities). Null if gap is not specialty-specific.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy, CMS Provider Specialty Codes

attributes.name: specialty_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the provider specialty or facility type that is deficient (e.g., Cardiology, Skilled Nursing Facility, Primary Care Physician). Null if gap is not specialty-specific.

attributes.name: standard_threshold
attributes.description: The regulatory or contractual adequacy standard threshold that must be met (e.g., '30 miles or 30 minutes', '1 PCP per 2000 members', '95% within 10 business days'). Format varies by standard type.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: standard_type
attributes.description: Type of network adequacy standard that this gap violates (time and distance, provider-to-member ratio, appointment availability, or essential community provider percentage requirement).
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, NAIC Model Act #74, ACA Section 1311

attributes.name: target_resolution_date
attributes.description: Planned date by which this adequacy gap is expected to be resolved or mitigated to meet the applicable standard.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

products.name: provider_directory
products.description: Published provider directory record representing the member-facing view of a provider's network participation, including full verification lifecycle tracking. Captures provider name, specialty, practice location, phone, accepting-new-patients status, telehealth availability, languages spoken, accessibility features (ADA compliance), last verified date, and directory publication channel (online, print, API). Embeds complete verification history as child records — including verification method (outbound call, online attestation, EHR/HIE data match, claims-based inference), verification date, verified fields (address, phone, accepting-new-patients, specialty), verification outcome (confirmed, updated, unable to reach), and verifying agent/system. Supports CMS directory accuracy requirements (42 CFR 422.111), No Surprises Act compliance, the 90-day directory update mandate, and quarterly verification tracking. This is the SSOT for member-facing directory data and its verification audit trail.
products.reference: CMS Provider Directory — 42 CFR 422.111 / No Surprises Act

products.name: vbc_arrangement
products.description: Master entity representing Value-Based Care (VBC) programs and their participation arrangements — covering both program design (program type, sponsoring entity, quality measure set, risk model, benchmark methodology) and specific ACO/VBC participation instances (ACO name, CMS ACO ID, arrangement dates, shared savings/risk terms, participating provider groups). Consolidates rating factors and rate quotes as stages within the underwriting case lifecycle. Links to the risk domain for RAF and HCC-based risk scoring at the group level. Supports the sales and renewal pipeline.

domains.name: contract
domains.description: Manages provider contracts, reimbursement agreements, capitation arrangements, fee schedules, value-based care (VBC) contracts, ACO agreements, risk-sharing models, contract terms, amendments, and contract lifecycle. Tracks contract effective dates, rate tables, and payment methodologies (fee-for-service, capitation, bundled payments). SSOT for all contractual and reimbursement terms between the health plan and providers.

products.name: provider_contract
products.description: Master record for all contractual agreements between the health plan and providers (physicians, hospitals, clinics, ancillary providers, DME suppliers), including formal contracts, Letters of Agreement (LOAs), Letters of Intent (LOIs), single-case agreements (SCAs), and out-of-network gap-fill arrangements. Captures contract type (fee-for-service, capitation, bundled payment, VBC/ACO, LOA, SCA), contract status, effective and termination dates, line of business (LOB) applicability, TPA/ASO designations, auto-renewal flags, contract tier, owning network, template reference, payment methodology classification, and service scope definitions (covered/excluded service categories, CPT/HCPCS ranges, revenue code ranges, DRG ranges, carve-out indicators, inclusion/exclusion flags). SSOT for all provider reimbursement agreements, interim arrangements, and contracted service scope. Sourced from Provider Management System (Cactus/ProviderSource) and Core Administration Platform (Facets/QNXT).

attributes.name: provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the provider contract record in the lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key for all contractual agreements between the health plan and providers.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.facility. Business justification: Facility contracts (hospital, outpatient center) are a distinct contracting process from professional provider contracts. Claims adjudication, network adequacy reporting, and facility billing all requ

attributes.name: fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fee schedule (rate table) governing reimbursement amounts for specific CPT/HCPCS procedure codes under this contract. Applicable for fee-for-service and bundled payment contracts.
attributes.references: CMS Physician Fee Schedule; AMA CPT Code Set; Core Administration Platform - Facets/QNXT

attributes.name: group_practice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.group_practice. Business justification: Group practices negotiate contracts as legal entities covering all member providers. Provider contracting operations require linking a contract to the group practice to determine which providers are c

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to plan.health_plan. Business justification: Provider contracts are explicitly plan-specific in health insurance — a provider may hold separate contracts for Medicare Advantage vs. commercial plans. Claims adjudication and contract management re

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider (physician, hospital, clinic, ancillary provider, or DME supplier) who is party to this contract. Sourced from Provider Management System (Cactus/ProviderSource).

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider network that owns or administers this contract (e.g., HMO network, PPO network, EPO network). Determines which network directory listings are governed by this contract.
attributes.references: Provider Management System - Cactus/ProviderSource; NCQA Network Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: amendment_date
attributes.description: Effective date of the most recent amendment to this contract. Used to determine which contract terms apply for a given date of service. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; State DOI Contract Filing Requirements

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the most recent amendment to this contract. Null for original, unamended contracts. Tracks the amendment sequence for audit and compliance purposes. Sourced from Cactus/ProviderSource.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; State DOI Contract Filing Requirements

attributes.name: aso_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract operates under an Administrative Services Only (ASO) arrangement where the employer self-funds claims and the health plan provides administrative services only. True = ASO arrangement.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 3(1); DOL ASO Regulations; NAIC Model Act

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract is configured to automatically renew upon reaching its termination date without requiring re-execution. True = auto-renews; False = requires manual renewal action.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; State DOI Contract Filing Requirements

attributes.name: capitation_rate_pmpm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Capitation Rate Per Member Per Month (PMPM)
attributes.description: Fixed monthly payment amount per enrolled member (Per Member Per Month - PMPM) paid to the provider under capitation contracts. Applicable only when payment_methodology = capitation. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: CMS Capitation Rate Setting Guidelines; NAIC Model Contract Standards; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 49

attributes.name: carve_out_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether specific services or benefit categories are carved out of this contract and managed under a separate arrangement (e.g., behavioral health carve-out, pharmacy carve-out). True = carve-outs exist.
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Carve-Out Guidance; NAIC Model Contract Standards

attributes.name: contract_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the contract as recorded in the Provider Management System. Used for display in contracting workflows, provider communications, and reporting dashboards.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable contract identifier assigned by the health plan contracting department. Used in correspondence, amendments, and provider communications. Sourced from Cactus/ProviderSource contract module.
attributes.references: Provider Management System - Cactus/ProviderSource; NAIC Model Contract Standards

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the provider contract. Drives eligibility verification, claims adjudication routing, and provider directory inclusion. Values: draft, pending_execution, active, suspended, terminated, expired, under_amendment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_execution|active|suspended|terminated|expired|under_amendment — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Core Administration Platform - Facets/QNXT; NAIC Model Contract Standards

attributes.name: contract_tier
attributes.description: Tiering classification assigned to this contract, reflecting the provider's preferred status and associated member cost-sharing levels. Tier 1/preferred providers typically have lower member cost-sharing. Used in benefit design and member-facing provider directory.
attributes.references: NCQA Network Adequacy Standards; CMS Tiered Network Guidance

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contractual arrangement by payment and relationship structure. Determines reimbursement methodology and applicable rate tables. Values: fee_for_service (FFS), capitation, bundled_payment, value_based_care (VBC/ACO), letter_of_agreement (LOA), single_case_agreement (SCA), out_of_network_gap_fill. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fee_for_service|capitation|bundled_payment|value_based_care|letter_of_agreement|single_case_agreement|out_of_network_gap_fill — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Payment Methodology Guidelines; NAIC Model Contract Standards; ACA Section 1311

attributes.name: cpt_range_end
attributes.description: Ending CPT or HCPCS procedure code defining the upper bound of the service scope covered under this contract. Used with cpt_range_start to define the range of covered procedures.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Code Set; CMS HCPCS Level II Codes; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162.1002

attributes.name: cpt_range_start
attributes.description: Starting CPT or HCPCS procedure code defining the lower bound of the service scope covered under this contract. Used with cpt_range_end to define the range of covered procedures. Sourced from AMA CPT code set.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Code Set; CMS HCPCS Level II Codes; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162.1002

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this provider contract record was first created in the lakehouse Silver layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164.312 (Audit Controls); Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: credentialing_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider must maintain active credentialing status as a condition of this contract. True = credentialing is a contractual requirement. Linked to NCQA credentialing standards.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC Credentialing Standards; State DOI Credentialing Requirements

attributes.name: delegation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether credentialing, utilization management, or other health plan functions have been delegated to the provider organization under this contract. True = delegation arrangement exists. Requires NCQA delegation oversight.
attributes.references: NCQA Delegation Standards; URAC Delegation Standards; CMS Delegation Requirements 42 CFR Part 422.504

attributes.name: drg_range_end
attributes.description: Ending Diagnosis Related Group (DRG) code defining the upper bound of inpatient service scope covered under this contract. Used with drg_range_start to define the range of covered DRGs.
attributes.references: CMS MS-DRG Classification System; ICD-10-CM/PCS; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: drg_range_start
attributes.description: Starting Diagnosis Related Group (DRG) code defining the lower bound of inpatient service scope covered under this contract. Applicable for hospital contracts with DRG-based payment methodology.
attributes.references: CMS MS-DRG Classification System; ICD-10-CM/PCS; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contract becomes legally binding and reimbursement terms take effect. Used in claims adjudication to determine applicable rate schedule. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment and Certification; NAIC Model Contract Standards; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which all parties signed and the contract was fully executed. May differ from effective_date for retroactive or prospective contracts. Sourced from Cactus/ProviderSource contract module.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; State DOI Contract Filing Requirements

attributes.name: lob_applicability
attributes.description: Line of Business (LOB) to which this contract applies. Determines which member populations and benefit plans are governed by this contract's reimbursement terms. Values: commercial, medicare_advantage, medicaid, marketplace, cobra, tricare, all. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commercial|medicare_advantage|medicaid|marketplace|cobra|tricare|all — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations 42 CFR Part 422; CMS Medicaid Managed Care 42 CFR Part 438; ACA Section 1311

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the contracting provider as assigned by CMS NPPES. 10-digit unique identifier used in EDI transactions (837/835) and claims adjudication to identify the contracted provider.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162.406; CMS NPPES NPI Registry

attributes.name: payment_methodology
attributes.description: Specific reimbursement calculation methodology governing how the health plan pays the provider under this contract. Distinct from contract_type in that it specifies the payment calculation approach. Examples: fee_for_service (FFS), capitation (PMPM), per_diem, case_rate, DRG-based, bundled, Reference Based Pricing (RBP), global_budget, salary. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fee_for_service|capitation|per_diem|case_rate|drg_based|bundled|rbp|global_budget|salary — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Payment Methodology Guidelines; NAIC Model Contract Standards; ACA Section 1311

attributes.name: provider_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contracted provider entity type. Drives applicable reimbursement rules, credentialing requirements, and service scope definitions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: physician|hospital|clinic|ancillary|dme_supplier|behavioral_health|skilled_nursing|home_health|laboratory|radiology — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NPI National Plan and Provider Enumeration System (NPPES); NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: quality_incentive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract includes quality-based incentive payments tied to HEDIS, STAR ratings, CAHPS, or other quality performance measures. True = quality incentive provisions exist in the contract.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Measures; CMS Star Ratings Program; CAHPS Survey Standards

attributes.name: raf_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Risk Adjustment Factor (RAF) / Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) coding obligations apply to the provider under this contract. True = provider has contractual HCC coding and encounter data submission requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment 42 CFR Part 422.310; CMS RAPS/EDPS; HCC Model Documentation

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days prior to the termination date by which either party must provide written notice of intent not to renew. Contractually mandated notice period for non-renewal. Typically 30, 60, or 90 days.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; State DOI Contract Filing Requirements

attributes.name: revenue_code_range_end
attributes.description: Ending UB-04 revenue code defining the upper bound of facility service categories covered under this contract. Used with revenue_code_range_start to define the range of covered revenue codes.
attributes.references: NUBC UB-04 Revenue Code Set; CMS Facility Billing Guidelines; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: revenue_code_range_start
attributes.description: Starting UB-04 revenue code defining the lower bound of facility service categories covered under this contract. Used for hospital and facility contracts to define covered service lines.
attributes.references: NUBC UB-04 Revenue Code Set; CMS Facility Billing Guidelines; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: risk_sharing_model
attributes.description: Specifies the financial risk-sharing arrangement between the health plan and provider under VBC or ACO contracts. Determines how savings and losses are allocated. Values: none, shared_savings, shared_risk, full_risk, upside_only, downside_only.
attributes.references: CMS Innovation Center ACO Models; CMS Medicare Shared Savings Program 42 CFR Part 425; NCQA VBC Standards

attributes.name: service_exclusion_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of specific services, procedures, or conditions explicitly excluded from the scope of this contract. Supplements the CPT/DRG/revenue code ranges with narrative exclusion details.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; CMS Managed Care Coverage Exclusion Guidelines

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this contract record was sourced. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation between Provider Management System and Core Administration Platform.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164.312 (Audit Controls)

attributes.name: source_system_contract_reference
attributes.description: Native contract identifier from the originating operational system (Cactus, ProviderSource, Facets, or QNXT). Enables traceability and reconciliation back to the system of record.
attributes.references: Provider Management System - Cactus/ProviderSource; Core Administration Platform - Facets/QNXT; Internal Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Federal Tax Identification Number (TIN) or Employer Identification Number (EIN) of the contracting provider entity. Used for 1099 reporting, payment processing, and IRS compliance. 9-digit numeric value.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162; CMS Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: template_code
attributes.description: Reference to the standard contract template used as the basis for this agreement. Enables tracking of which template version governs the contract terms and supports template-level compliance audits.
attributes.references: Provider Management System - Cactus/ProviderSource; NAIC Model Contract Standards

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contract ceases to be binding. Null for open-ended contracts. Used to determine provider in-network status for claims with dates of service at or before this date. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment and Certification; NAIC Model Contract Standards

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance written notice required by either party to terminate the contract for convenience (without cause). Distinct from renewal_notice_days which applies at contract expiry.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; State DOI Contract Filing Requirements; CMS Provider Termination Notice Requirements

attributes.name: tpa_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract is administered by a Third Party Administrator (TPA) on behalf of the health plan. True = TPA-administered; False = directly administered by the health plan. Relevant for ASO arrangements.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 3(16); DOL TPA Regulations; NAIC Model TPA Act

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this provider contract record was last modified in the lakehouse Silver layer. Used for incremental load detection and change data capture. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164.312 (Audit Controls); Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: vbc_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract includes Value-Based Care (VBC) components such as quality bonuses, shared savings, or risk-sharing arrangements beyond standard fee-for-service reimbursement.
attributes.references: CMS Innovation Center VBC Models; ACA Section 3022 (ACO); NCQA VBC Standards

products.name: party
products.description: Identifies all parties bound by a provider contract — the health plan entity, the contracting provider (individual NPI or organizational NPI), group practice, IPA, ACO, or hospital system. Tracks party role (payer, provider, delegated entity), NPI, TIN, legal entity name, signatory authority, and party effective dates. Supports multi-party and delegated contracting arrangements.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each party record in the provider contract domain. Serves as the primary key for all contractual party references across the health plan enterprise.
attributes.references: HIPAA Administrative Simplification; CMS Provider Enrollment Standards

attributes.name: provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider contract this party is bound by. Links the party record to its governing contractual agreement within the contract domain.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment Standards; NAIC Model Contract Law

attributes.name: aco_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is an Accountable Care Organization (ACO) participating in a value-based care (VBC) arrangement. Triggers ACO-specific contract terms, shared savings calculations, and CMS reporting requirements.
attributes.references: CMS ACO Regulations 42 CFR Part 425; CMS Shared Savings Program; ACA Section 3022

attributes.name: capitation_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is eligible to receive capitation payments (Per Member Per Month - PMPM) under the contract. Drives capitation payment processing and actuarial PMPM rate application.
